missions.west_coast_usa.timeTrial.wcusa_: Test vehicle performance in this challenging course transitioning from flat waterfront straights to steep downtown inclines.

This advanced assessment focuses on powertrain and handling dynamics during significant elevation changes. Begin along the flat waterfront section before tackling the steep urban ascents.

We're measuring how effectively vehicles maintain power delivery and stability when transitioning between flat surfaces and inclines. This data helps optimize engine mapping, transmission control, and weight distribution systems.

Pay special attention to throttle response changes as you climb and how momentum management affects overall efficiency. Note any hesitation during transition phases.

Complete this evaluation with our test vehicle first before using your own for comparative analysis.
Elevation Transition Analysis
Evaluate vehicle dynamics on Belasco City's demanding financial district course featuring extreme elevation changes combined with technical 90-degree corners.

This specialized assessment focuses on combined cornering and climbing capabilities. Navigate through the financial district's steep hills and consecutive 90-degree turns between Belasco's iconic skyscrapers.

ui.modWizard.skinWizard.right: The right side of the image is the "SkinExample_palette_uv1.dds". This image is used to define which parts of your skin can be colored by the color selector. ui.experiences.leisurelyDrive.title: Leisurely Drive
ui.experiences.leisurelyDrive.descriptio: Get accustomed to the controls and drive through the streets of Italy.
ui.experiences.leisurelyDrive.task.subte: Follow the route or use the Map to set your own destination.
ui.experiences.johnsonValley.title: Offroad Trails
ui.experiences.johnsonValley.description: Try out a few different vehicles and trails in the rocks and dunes of Johnson Valley.
ui.experiences.johnsonValley.task.subtex: Use the Radial Menu to change vehicles. Approach a trail marker and accept it to start the trail.
ui.experiences.trackday.title: Open Track Day
ui.experiences.trackday.description: Take a selection of high performance cars out for a spin on Hirochi Raceway.
ui.experiences.trackday.task1.label: Take the cars for a spin!
ui.experiences.trackday.task1.subtext: There's multiple vehicles for you to try out. Use the Radial Menu to change vehicles.
ui.experiences.trackday.task2.subtext: Check out the race tracks and the drag strip. Use the Map to set a route.
ui.experiences.propDestruction.title: Prop Destruction
ui.experiences.propDestruction.descripti: Destroy a variety of props by smashing them with your car.
ui.experiences.propDestruction.task.labe: Drive into props and smash them with your car.
ui.experiences.propDestruction.task.subt: You can use the Radial Menu to change and reset props.
ui.experiences.ramplow.title: Traffic Mayhem
ui.experiences.ramplow.description: Cause mayhem in and around West Coast USA, Belasco City.
ui.experiences.ramplow.task.label: Cause some havoc!
ui.experiences.ramplow.task.subtext: You can use the Radial Menu to change vehicles and traffic behaviour.
ui.experiences.missions.smallIslandPursu: Arrest the fleeing suspect by chasing them down and immobilizing them.
ui.experiences.missions.getDown.title: Damage Trial
ui.experiences.missions.getDown.descript: Throw yourself off a cliff and observe the damage.
ui.experiences.missions.garageToGarage.d: Deliver randomly selected vehicles all over Italy.
ui.experiences.missions.tasticolaRestock: Deliver a large trailer full of TastiCola to the specified location.
ui.experiences.missions.orchardHill.desc: A short uphill sprint that utlizes pacenotes for guidance.
ui.experiences.missions.ringRoad.title: Road Race
ui.experiences.missions.ringRoad.descrip: Race various drivers on the ring road around Small Island.
ui.experiences.missions.slitheryDriftSho: A short and difficult drifting course on Italy's mountainside.
ui.experiences.missions.ridgewayRider.de: Crawl through a rocky canyon in Johnson Valley.
ui.experiences.missions.barrelKnocker.de: Gain points by knocking away barrels on the road.
ui.experiences.missions.dragStripRace.de: Race against random opponents on the drag strip of Hirochi Raceway.
ui.experiences.missions.038_quarrycapers: Race the 5 opponents around the road and quarry site, in a lap that will test your mettle.
ui.experiences.missions.038_blockTruck.d: Rotate trailers between the two cutting sites. Take the empty one up and bring the loaded one back to the end zone.
Deliver two nineteen-ton blocks of marble to the cutting area.
ui.experiences.missions.038_quarrytt1.de: How fast can you lap the quarry loop?
ui.experiences.missions.038_quarryG2G.ti: Garage to Garage at the Italian Quarry
ui.experiences.missions.038_quarryG2G.de: Transport heavy machinery around the Italian quarry.
ui.experiences.missions.038_quarryRace.d: Race work pickup trucks around a course inside the Italian quarry.
Retrieve the loaded trailer and take it down to the finishing zone via the coastal road.
ui.experiences.popups.basicDriving.title: Basic Driving Controls
ui.experiences.popups.basicDriving.subte: These are the default bindings and can be customized in the settings.
ui.experiences.discover_037.limousine.de: Take the new Grand Marshal Limousine for a testdrive around Belasco City.
ui.experiences.discover_037.description: Experience the thrill of remastered destructive props like spinners and large cannons, along with the elegance of the new Grand Marshal Limousine in the 2025 Fall Update.
ui.experiences.discover_037.destructiveP: Wreck the cars with the new destructive props, such as spinners, cannons, and more.
You can switch to the props. Some props can be operated using walking mode.
ui.experiences.discover_038.description: Put the Hirochi HT-55 Haul Truck and the Hirochi WL-40 Wheel Loader through their paces by hauling around marble blocks and rocks in the new Quarry area in Italy. We've also added some new missions designed to showcase their power.
ui.experiences.discover_038.forklift.des: Try out the forklift by trying to stack some old cars.
ui.experiences.discover_038.forklift.tas: The arm is powered by hydraulics which requires the engine to run. Hydraulic speed is directly proportional to the engines RPM.
Use the loader controls to control the arm and fork attachment.
Try to lift the cars and stack them.
ui.experiences.discover_038.logLoader.de: Use the log sorting grapple to load logs into the trailer.
ui.experiences.discover_038.logLoader.ta: Use the loader controls to control the arm and thumb.
The arm and thumb are powered by hydraulics which requires the engine to run. Hydraulic speed is directly proportional to the engines RPM.
Try to load the logs onto the truck.
ui.experiences.discover_038.rockslide.de: Drop a bunch of rocks on unsuspecting vehicles.
ui.experiences.discover_038.rockslide.ta: Enter the vehicle or use the Radial Menu, then carefully reverse the truck to the edge of the cliff.
When you are at the edge of the cliff, raise the bed.
ui.experiences.discover_038.quarry.title: Heavy Machinery
ui.experiences.discover_038.quarry.descr: Try out the new Hirochi HT‑55 haul truck and WL‑40 wheel loader. Move around large chunks of marble and rocks in the new Quarry area in Italy.
ui.experiences.discover_039.description:
(Placeholder)Try out the new freeform delivery mode! These missions focus on realism and are thus more difficult than the regular missions. You can use the map and walking mode.
 Freeform delivery system is still WIP, but early feedback is appreciated!
ui.experiences.newPlayerExperience.title: New Player Experience
ui.experiences.newPlayerExperience.descr: Get used to the controls and explore a selection of beginner-friendly experiences and challenges.
ui.experiences.missions.039_logs.descrip: A challenging log delivery mission in East Coast USA. Bring as many logs from the the forestry to the sawmill as you can.
ui.experiences.missions.039_racecar.desc: Deliver the race car from the loading station to the client's house, then return.
ui.experiences.missions.039_wrecks.descr: Take a truck and trailer to recover abandoned vehicles using a wheel loader, then bring them back to the autoshop.
ui.experiences.missions.039_quarryloader: Take a flatbed trailer up to the quarry, load a block onto it with a wheel loader, then bring the block to the block yard.
ui.experiences.missions.039_sshunter.des: Locate the trailers around the port and park them in their designated spots.
ui.experiences.missions.039_dduty.descri: Locate the trailers around the port and park them in their designated spots.
ui.experiences.missions.039_cargoshifter: Drive to work at the break of dawn, deliver some goods around WCUSA with a truck and then head back home.

ui.options.shiftMode.title: Gearbox Mode
ui.options.shiftMode.description: [b]BeamNG.drive[/b] offers you a range of options to customize your driving experience. Whether you prefer arcade-style driving or full control, you can find the perfect setting for you.
ui.options.shiftMode.arcadeDesc: In [b]Arcade Gearbox Mode[/b], the game takes care of managing gears for you. Use throttle [action=accelerate] and brake [action=brake] to go forward and reverse. Best for casual players who just want to drive.
ui.options.shiftMode.realisticDesc: In [b]Realistic Gearbox Mode[/b], you control the gearbox yourself by shifting up [action=shiftUp] and down [action=shiftDown]. Best for immersion and full control.
ui.options.shiftMode.footer: Use the [b]Radial Menu[/b] [action=toggleRadialMenuMulti] or press [b]{{'ui.inputActions.vehicle.toggleShifterMode.title' | translate}}[/b] [action=toggleShifterMode] while seated in a vehicle to change the gearbox mode.
ui.options.shiftMode.clutchAssistant.des: Clutch assistant handles the clutch for you. It helps with moving off from a standstill, prevents stalling and shifts gears smoothly. You can still use the [action=clutch] binding to manually control the clutch.

You handle the clutch [action=clutch] yourself. Use it to move off from a standstill, prevent stalling and to keep the gearbox undamaged when shifting gears. Best for full control or when you have a physical clutch pedal.
ui.options.shiftMode.throttleAssistant.d: Throttle assistant manages throttle input during shifting and rev-matching for vehicles with a manual transmission.
You control throttle [action=accelerate] entirely yourself during launches and shifting for full manual behavior.
ui.options.shiftMode.additionalAssists.t: Check out more assistant options and in-depth settings in the [b]Options[/b] [action=toggleMenues] > [b]Gameplay[/b] > [b]Driving Assistants[/b] section.
ui.options.gameplay.autoClutch.tooltip: If enabled, the clutch is automatically controlled in realistic mode. Launches cars nicely, prevents stalling and makes sure to not break gears when shifting.
ui.options.gameplay.autoThrottle.tooltip: If enabled, manual transmissions cut the throttle on up-shifting and use rev-matching where required.
ui.options.gameplay.gearboxSafety.toolti: If enabled, gearboxes will deny shifts that might cause damage as well as prevent certain mode changes for a more immersive racing experience. (For example shifting out of M mode is disallowed until you are below a certain speed)

ui.options.graphics.GraphicMeshQualityTo:
Adjusts objects quality at distance.
Reducing this setting will allow objects to switch into lower quality earlier improving performance of CPU and GPU.

[b]Ultra[/b] - Multiplies objects detail distance by 2.
[b]High[/b] - Multiplies objects detail distance by 1.5.
[b]Normal[/b] - Regular objects detail distance.
[b]Low[/b] - Reduces objects detail distance by quarter.
[b]Lowest[/b] - Reduces objects detail distance by half.

[b][*]GPU:[/b] Major[b][*]VRAM:[/b] None[b][*]CPU:[/b] Moderate
ui.options.graphics.GraphicTextureQualit:
Adjusts maximum textures resolution.
Higher settings will give more detailed results but will impact GPU memory and texture streaming performance.

[b]Normal[/b] - Full resolution of textures.
[b]Low[/b] - Half resolution of textures.
[b]Lowest[/b] - Quarter resolution of textures.

[b]Note:[/b] Texture streaming is used only in Vulkan and Direct3D 12 API. Texture resolution might be lower when GPU memory is full.

[b][*]GPU:[/b] Minor[b][*]VRAM:[/b] Major[b][*]CPU:[/b] None
ui.options.graphics.GraphicTerrainQualit:
Adjusts terrain quality at distance.
Lowering this setting will reduce complexity of terrain earlier improving GPU performance.

[b]High[/b] - Multiplies terrain detail distance by 1.5.
[b]Normal[/b] - Regular terrain detail distance.
[b]Low[/b] - Reduces terrain detail distance by quarter.
[b]Lowest[/b] - Reduces terrain detail distance by half.

[b][*]GPU:[/b] Moderate[b][*]VRAM:[/b] Minor[b][*]CPU:[/b] None
ui.options.graphics.GraphicLightingQuali:
Adjusts lighting and shadow quality.
Higher settings enable more advanced lighting, improved specular reflections, and smoother shadow filtering at the cost of GPU performance.

[b]Ultra[/b] - Advanced lighting with PCSS contact-hardening with higher quality soft shadow filtering.
[b]High[/b] - Advanced lighting with soft shadow filtering.
[b]Low[/b] - Simplified advanced lighting with soft shadow filtering.
[b]Lowest[/b] - Basic lighting without shadow filtering.

[b][*]GPU:[/b] Major[b][*]VRAM:[/b] Minor[b][*]CPU:[/b] Moderate
ui.options.graphics.GraphicCloudsQuality:
Adjusts how detailed the volumetric clouds look and how smooth their cloud shadows appear.
Higher settings render clouds at a higher internal resolution and update cloud shadow data more often, making clouds sharper and shadows less blocky, at the cost of GPU performance.

[b]High[/b] - Very sharp clouds and smooth cloud shadows.
[b]Normal[/b] - Balanced quality and performance.
[b]Low[/b] - Softest clouds and most blocky cloud shadows.

[b][*]GPU:[/b] Major[b][*]VRAM:[/b] Minor[b][*]CPU:[/b] None
ui.options.graphics.GraphicShadowsQualit:
Adjusts shadow resolution.
Higher shadow resolution requires more GPU memory and processing power.

[b]Ultra[/b] - Optional setting for high-end GPUs. Uses the highest shadow resolution and requires more VRAM and GPU performance.
[b]High[/b] - Double shadow resolution.
[b]Normal[/b] - Regular shadow resolution.
[b]Low[/b] - Half resolution shadows.
[b]Lowest[/b] - Quarter resolution shadows.
[b]None[/b] - Shadows are disabled.

[b][*]GPU:[/b] High[b][*]VRAM:[/b] High[b][*]CPU:[/b] Minor
ui.options.graphics.GraphicClusteredQual:
Controls the rendering distance, amount, and quality of local lights and their dynamic shadows.
At higher settings, a greater number of lights and shadows will remain visible farther from the camera, at the cost of GPU performance.

[b]Ultra[/b] - Maximum light count and detail with the longest-range, highest-quality shadows.
[b]High[/b] - High light count, with long-range, detailed shadows.
[b]Normal[/b] - Balanced quality and performance, with reduced light count, detail, and shadow range.
[b]Low[/b] - Fewer lights, with short-range, simpler shadows.

ui.controls.filter.tooltip: Allows to improve sudden inputs (such as pressing the brake button, or quickly pushing the steering stick) into smoother, more realistic, more controllable requests.[list][*][b]{{'ui.controls.filters.-1'|translate}}[/b]: the simulator will make a reasonable guess and choose one of the options below for you. [b]Choose this if in doubt[/b][*][b]{{'ui.controls.filters.0'|translate}}[/b]: tailored for digital controls like buttons. It will gradually apply your input over a few tenths of a second. Advanced drivers can constantly tap the button to control the amount of input. [i]In the case of steering buttons, some additional logic will make it slightly easier to stay close to optimum cornering forces.[/i][*][b]{{'ui.controls.filters.3'|translate}}[/b]: like '{{'ui.controls.filters.0'|translate}}'. [i]In the case of steering buttons, some additional logic will speed up response when oversteering, at the expense of smoothness.[/i][*][b]{{'ui.controls.filters.1'|translate}}[/b]: geared towards small analog controls, such as a stick. It provides a faster response than previous filters, with less smoothing. [i]In the case of steering bindings, it will slightly speed up countersteering.[/i][*][b]{{'ui.controls.filters.2'|translate}}[/b]: no filter is applied, your inputs will reach the simulation instantaneously and with complete transparency. [b]Choose this for the steering axis if using a steering wheel[/b].[/list]
ui.controls.angle.tooltip: If you are using a steering wheel, choose the same angle that your connected steering wheel is configured to (often 900 or 1080 degrees).[br][br]It's recommended to configure your steering wheel drivers to the maximum possible angle that your hardware allows, and then choose that same angle here, in this menu. That will allow you to drive a wider range of vehicles using realistic steering inputs (whether they are a quick-steering rally car or a large-steering truck).[br][br]Setting the angle:[list][*]Allows the vehicle steering wheel to match the angle of your real steering wheel (see '{{'ui.controls.lockType'|translate}}' setting).[*]Allows the '{{'ui.controls.ffb.softlockForce'|translate}}' setting to work (requires force feedback).[*]Forces the '{{'ui.controls.filter'|translate}}' setting to '{{'ui.controls.filters.2'|translate}}', for convenience.[/list]Note: if you are [b]not[/b] using a steering wheel, choose 0 degrees.
lockType.syncOk: ✔️Real and virtual steering wheels turn in sync.
lockType.syncMeh1: ➕Real and virtual steering wheels turn in sync until half lock, and faster in trucks near full lock.
lockType.syncMeh2: ➕Real and virtual steering wheels turn in sync in racecars, and faster in trucks.
lockType.syncBad: ❌Real and virtual steering wheels don't turn in sync.
ui.controls.lockTypes.tooltip: Different vehicles have different lock-to-lock steering wheel angles. For example trucks use large angles, while racecars use small angles.[br][br]This means that your connected steering wheel might turn too little or too much, depending on the particular vehicle you are driving.[br][br]This setting lets you decide how that mismatch is handled:[list][*][b]'{{'ui.controls.lockTypes.2'|translate}}'[/b] *[br]{{'lockType.raceOk'|translate}}[br]{{'lockType.truckOk'|translate}}[br]{{'lockType.syncMeh1'|translate}}[*][b]'{{'ui.controls.lockTypes.3'|translate}}'[/b] *[br]{{'lockType.raceOk'|translate}}[br]{{'lockType.truckOk'|translate}}[br]{{'lockType.syncMeh2'|translate}}[*][b]'{{'ui.controls.lockTypes.1'|translate}}'[/b] *[br]{{'lockType.raceOk'|translate}}[br]{{'lockType.truckBad'|translate}}[br]{{'lockType.syncOk'|translate}}[*][b]'{{'ui.controls.lockTypes.0'|translate}}'[/b][br]{{'lockType.raceBad'|translate}}[br]{{'lockType.truckOk'|translate}}[br]{{'lockType.syncBad'|translate}}[/list]** requires a correct '{{'ui.controls.angle'|translate}}' setting*
ui.controls.ffb.feedbackMode.tooltip: Set the feedback type between force feedback and vibration.
ui.controls.ffb.enableThrottleForceFeedb: Enable vibration feedback when the wheels lose traction under throttle (if the controller supports it).
ui.controls.ffb.enableBrakeForceFeedback: Enable vibration feedback when the wheels lock up under braking (if the controller supports it).
ui.controls.ffb.deviceLightingMode.toolt: Set the RPM lights mode for the device.
ui.controls.ffb.isForceInverted.tooltip: Use this if your wheel force is turning the opposite direction to which it should.[br][br]For example, use this if a parked vehicle tends to steer by itself into full lock left or full lock right.
ui.controls.ffb.torque.tooltip: The '{{'ui.controls.ffb.torqueCurrent'|translate}}' and '{{'ui.controls.ffb.torqueDesired'|translate}}' options allow to limit the amount of force feedback during extreme circumstances, such as during crashes.[br]To set them up:[list][*]Open the configuration software for your steering wheel.[*]Locate how many Newtons-meter of torque are currently selected. [br][i]Note: you can increase this value to the maximum - in some steering wheels, this might unlock better force feedback response.[/i][*]Head back to this options menu, and pick that same value in the '{{'ui.controls.ffb.torqueCurrent'|translate}}' slider.[*]Finally, pick a '{{'ui.controls.ffb.torqueDesired'|translate}}' that you are comfortable with. Picking a value higher than the '{{'ui.controls.ffb.torqueCurrent'|translate}}' is equivalent to picking the '{{'ui.controls.ffb.torqueCurrent'|translate}}'.[br][i]Note: high values can pose a risk for your hands and wrists (around 4Nm for adults, 1Nm for children). Be cautious and try low values first.[/i][/list]If correctly configured, the simulator will not exceed the specified '{{'ui.controls.ffb.torqueDesired'|translate}}'.
ui.controls.ffb.strength.tooltip: For [b]'{{'ui.controls.ffb.feedbackMode.vibration'|translate}}'[/b]: use 100 as starting point, then tweak to your liking.[br][br]For [b]'{{'ui.controls.ffb.feedbackMode.forceFeedback'|translate}}'[/b]: the more powerful the steering wheel is, the lower the strength you'll need to choose here. A good starting point is:[list][*]Entry level wheels configured to 1-3Nm: use 350 to 500[*]Mid range wheels configured to 3-5Nm: use 200 to 350[*]High end wheels configured to 5-30Nm: use 50 to 200[/list]If the chosen strength is too high, the most subtle details may become more noticeable, but the medium and strong details will max out and blend together, losing useful feedback. This is called [i]clipping[/i], and it happens because the steering wheel is being asked for more torque than it can produce.[br][br]You can check for clipping with the UI apps '{{'ui.apps.steering_position.name'|translate}}' and '{{'ui.apps.ffb_graph.name'|translate}}'. We recommend you reduce the strength until clipping happens rarely (or happens only in situations where you don't mind the lack of detail).[br][br]Note: force feedback in certain vehicles could be weaker or stronger than average (such as mods that weren't tested with a steering wheel). You can tune those vehicles individually through {{'ui.dashboard.vehicleconfig'|translate}} > {{'ui.vehicleconfig.tuning'|translate}} > Setup-specific force feedback multiplier.
ui.controls.ffb.softlockForce.tooltip: When your steering wheel is turned beyond the maximum steering lock of the current vehicle, this setting will apply a force to pull it back into a valid steering angle.[br][br]Requires having set a valid '{{'ui.controls.angle'|translate}}'.[br][br]A smoother effect can be achieved with higher framerates and a lower '{{'ui.controls.ffb.softlockForce'|translate}}'.
ui.controls.ffb.gforceCoef.tooltip: Applies a force proportional to the lateral acceleration experienced by the vehicle. This additional torque is mixed on top of the regular torque from the steering rack, and might help gauge the vehicle behaviour.[br][br]In real life, this force isn't felt through the hands at the steering wheel, but through the body being pushed when cornering.[br][br]Using this setting will lead to forces that would be unexpected in real life (such as unrealistic self-centering effects in some situations), so it's down to personal preference.
ui.controls.ffb.lowspeedCoef.tooltip: Helps reduce oscillations when the vehicle is parked (or rolling slowly).[br][br]If in doubt, enable this setting. If your driving style is mostly rock-crawling (or similarly low speed maneuvers) you may prefer it disabled.[br][br]Note: if the steering wheel is not being held, oscillations are likely to happen even with this setting enabled.
ui.controls.ffb.logitechVibrotactileCoef: Controls the vibrotactile force generated from sounds (if your device supports Logitech Trueforce)
ui.controls.ffb.logitechVibrotactileFreq: Controls the approximate maximum sound frequency that will generate vibrotactile forces (if your device supports Logitech Trueforce)
ui.controls.ffb.smoothing.tooltip: Can be used to reduce vibrations in the steering wheel (high frequency spikes).[br][br]Don't abuse this setting: greater values will make force feedback smoother at the expense of removing progressively more detail. It will also increase latency, which can lead to oscillations (specially when setting a high '{{'ui.controls.ffb.strength'|translate}}', or when the steering wheel is not being held).[br][br]Pick the lowest possible value for more responsiveness.
ui.controls.ffb.smoothing2automatic.tool: A sensible default value will be chosen automatically.[br][br]Untick this option if you want to experiment with different values.
ui.controls.ffb.smoothing2.tooltip: Can be used to reduce larger vibrations in the steering wheel (lower frequency oscillations).[br][br]Abusing this setting will compromise the amount of detail and responsiveness you can feel through the steering wheel, so tweak with care.[br][br][b]If in doubt, use '{{'ui.controls.ffb.smoothing2automatic'|translate}}' instead.[/b]
ui.controls.ffb.updateRateLimit.tooltip: How often the physics engine is allowed to send force feedback updates to the steering wheel:[list][*]High values improve detail, but a value too high can severely impact your framerate or increase ffb lag.[*]A value too low (such as 30Hz) won't feel smooth.[*]'{{'ui.controls.ffb.updateRateLimit.automatic'|translate}}' will guess the fastest usable rate, by running a quick analysis each time you use the steering wheel. [b]If in doubt, use this.[/b][/list][i]'{{'ui.controls.ffb.updateRateLimit.automatic'|translate}}' is not perfect: in very rare cases you may need to manually choose an even lower rate to avoid performance issues.[/i][br][br]Note: the real update rate depends on several factors and external limitations; this option merely imposes an upper limit.
ui.controls.ffb.updateType.tooltip: Allows to choose between two internal methods of sending the force feedback requests:[list][*]'[i]{{'ui.controls.ffb.updateType.fast'|translate}}[/i]': [b]if in doubt, use this[/b].[*]'[i]{{'ui.controls.ffb.updateType.slow'|translate}}[/i]': this slow alternative can reduce the framerate. It should only be used as a workaround for some rare buggy steering wheels.[/list]If your steering wheel works better when using '[i]{{'ui.controls.ffb.updateType.slow'|translate}}[/i]', please search for firmware and driver updates. If the issue persists, contact our support team.
ui.controls.ffb.responseCorrected.toolti: Allows to customize how the steering wheel will respond to various torque requests.[br][br]For example, increasing response of lower torques and decreasing response of higher torques, compensating for a non-linear response, etc.[br][br][b]Please check the Steering Wheel Setup documentation page for details.[/b][br][br]Quick guide: once this setting is enabled and applied, place a curve file in your [code]settings/inputmaps/[/code] directory, press ctrl+L, press Apply and reopen this menu. The inputmap .diff file will be automatically updated with the new curve data.[br][br]Accepted filenames:[list][*]wheel.csv (universal format, each line having a force,response pair of values; header lines are ignored, and any numeric scale can be used, as it will be automatically normalized and sanitized)[*]wheel.lut (compatible with Assetto Corsa™ ff_post_process curves)[*]wheel.log (compatible with iRacing™ WheelCheck csv files using log-2 option)[*]wheel.fcm (compatible with Project Cars™ Force Curve Modifier exported files using linear force response option)[/list]

ui.hints.quickSteerResponse: For quicker steering response, try different filters for the steering bindings.
ui.hints.raceBrakesEffectiveness: Race brakes will lose effectiveness when they are too cold.
ui.hints.quickCameraMovement: You can increase the speed of some cameras using a dedicated binding.
ui.hints.grabVehicleParts: You can grab parts of the vehicle by using the node grabber and then dragging with your mouse.
ui.hints.funStabilityControl: Cars with stability control can switch to more dangerous (but fun) modes.
ui.hints.recoverVehicle: If your vehicle gets stuck, recover it to move it to a clear position and repair it.
ui.hints.oldCarsBurn: Some old cars are prone to catching fire after a crash, but modern cars are much safer.
ui.hints.smokingWheels: If smoke comes out of the wheel wells, it's likely that the brakes have overheated.
ui.hints.carsBurnFuel: Your vehicle may run out of fuel after very long runs. Watch the fuel gauge!
ui.hints.delicateCars: Some cars are not designed to be driven hard. Keep an eye on the temperature gauge!
ui.hints.stabilityControlPresent: Stability control is only present in the most modern vehicles. Older cars will be harder to control at the limit.
ui.hints.absWasOptional: Anti-lock brakes haven't always been mandatory. Older cars require more careful braking techniques to keep them under control.
ui.hints.installRollCage: You can install roll cages in some vehicles: this improves vehicle handling by stiffening the body and chassis.
ui.hints.spatialNavigation: You can navigate the menu using a controller.
ui.hints.slowMotionPhysics: You can admire the physics in slow motion. Try slowing down right before a crash!
ui.hints.removeRearSeats: Make your vehicle faster by removing unnecessary weight such as the rear seats, using the Parts Selector.
ui.hints.tuning: You can tweak tire pressure, alignment, and other settings in the "Tuning" menu.
ui.hints.customLicensePlate: You can customize the license plate text in the Parts Selector.
ui.hints.driveAtNight: You can drive at night by changing the settings in the "Environment" menu.
ui.hints.moonGravity: You can simulate moon gravity in the "Environment" menu.
ui.hints.unlockExtraFunctionality: Unlock extra functionality by enabling the 'Options' > 'User Interface' > 'Advanced Functions' checkbox.
ui.hints.playMultiseat: Plug in several controllers and play with your friends at home, by opening any of the Multiseat scenarios.
ui.hints.increaseGroundClearance: Increase the ride height of your off-road vehicle if you are having trouble crossing a river.
ui.hints.tiresBurstOnBumps: Not all tires are designed for high speeds and loads. Some will burst when hitting bumps too fast.
ui.hints.blueSmokeIsPistonDamage: If you see blue smoke coming out of the exhaust, oil is being burnt, indicating piston ring damage.
ui.hints.keepTheEngineUpright: Operating an engine upside down causes oil starvation. Blue exhaust smoke will occur from oil submerging the cylinders, and the engine bearings could fail.
ui.hints.thermalDebugApp: To learn more about the engine simulation, you can add the "Engine Thermal Debug" app to the UI.
ui.hints.rollPitchApps: If you like crawling through rocks, the "Roll" and "Pitch" UI apps may be useful.
ui.hints.cruiseControlApp: For long, relaxed trips on the highway you can add the "Cruise Control" UI app. It works for all cars!
ui.hints.driveTheCanon: Did you know you can drive (and fire!) a cannon? Filter by "Prop" Type in the Vehicle selector.
ui.hints.vehicleSkins: Some vehicles have alternate skins. You can find them in the Parts Selector, under Paint Design.
ui.hints.toggleMods: You can quickly disable and enable all mods by pressing "Active All"/"None" in the Mod Manager.
ui.hints.importveFramerate: To improve your framerate, check the tips listed under Help > Performance > Basic Performance Improvements
ui.hints.photoModeMenu: The Photo Mode menu provides advanced control over the camera and an option for direct image upload to BeamNG servers.
ui.hints.publishScreenshots: If you like shooting photos of your ride, you can hide the UI take a screenshot that gets uploaded automatically.
ui.hints.towTrailer: To tow a trailer with your truck: spawn both, approach the trailer, and attach it.
ui.hints.brakesAndSteeringVary: Each vehicle has different braking and cornering abilities. Get to know them before driving at the limit.
ui.hints.countersteerEarly: If a vehicle starts fishtailing from side to side, you need to countersteer earlier and faster. Using a steering wheel (or controller) is highly recommended.
ui.hints.startSlow: It's easy to run wide in corners when driving a vehicle for the first time. Start slow, and drive faster as you get to know how each vehicle handles.
ui.hints.parkingbrakeForTurning: Use the parking brake as a quick and dangerous way to turn around.
ui.hints.carefulWithOldSportsCars: Old sports cars without electronic aids can be difficult to control and require gentle application of the throttle.
ui.hints.corneringWithKeyboard: When cornering with buttons, repeatedly tap steering inputs to better control the steering angle and prevent unwanted understeer.
ui.hints.adaptToBadRoads: Old roads with bumps, tarmac patches and surface unevenness will limit cornering speed. You'll need to adapt your speed according to road conditions.
ui.hints.notAllCarsCanRace: Many vehicles are not suited for spirited driving or racing in stock form. Aftermarket upgrades are available in the Parts Selector.
ui.hints.changeBrakePads: If you experience brake fade, you can fit better brake pads in the Parts Selector.
ui.hints.useTurnSignals: Did you know most vehicles have working turn signals? This is also true in our simulator!
ui.hints.showStandalonePcs: To show your own custom vehicle configurations, enable the relevant checkbox on the right panel.
ui.hints.tweakFOV: The camera field of view can be tweaked in Options > Camera.
ui.hints.driveWithMouse: You can drive using your mouse too. You can go to the controls menu to assign new bindings to your liking.
ui.hints.liftOffOversteer: Suddenly lifting the throttle in a high speed corner can unsettle the vehicle and lead to a loss of control. This is called "lift-off" oversteer.
ui.hints.snapOversteer: Cars with more weight on the rear wheels can have a tendency to initially understeer with throttle application, and then oversteer suddenly. This is called "snap" oversteer.
ui.hints.slideBackWithParkingBrake: You can slide the back of nose-heavy front-wheel drive vehicles easily with the parking brake, especially on loose surfaces.
ui.hints.customizeSpecializedBindings: You can customize vehicle-specific bindings (used in car crusher, cannon, etc) by pressing them on the top-right corner of the screen.
ui.hints.toggleFogLights: If your vehicle is equipped with fog lights, you can toggle them.
ui.hints.toggleLightBars: Light bars in emergency vehicles can be toggled.
ui.hints.TrackIRSupported: This BeamNG application supports the TrackIR head tracking device; just plug it in and restart the application!
ui.hints.chooseShiftingMode: To change the default shifting mode, go to Options > Gameplay.
ui.hints.saveRestoreVehicleHome: You can save the vehicle home and later restore it.
ui.hints.switchVehicle: Switch between vehicles with the vehicle switching bindings.
ui.hints.coolantVaporizes: Overheating coolant may vaporize, making a hot engine harder to cool down after long periods of overheating. You can repair the vehicle to reset the coolant level.
ui.hints.dontRunIntoTheCar: It's not a good idea to sprint at full speed into cars. This applies not only to real life, but also to our simulator. You can damage the car by doing it.
ui.hints.repairHood: If you crashed and the hood is now blocking your vision, you can exit the car and jump on it to try to flatten it.

scenarios.busRoutes.startText:
The objective of this challenge is to complete the entire bus stop route with the highest possible scores.

To get these scores:

  • Drive without damage.
  • Park well at stops.
  • Do not skip any stop where passengers want to get off and / or get on.
There will be passengers at the stops waiting to be picked up and those who are already on the bus will also request to get off the bus. At the end of the route you will be provided with the scores obtained and you will be given the choice between ending the challenge or continuing with the reverse route in order to try again.
scenarios.busRoutes.endText:
Congratulations, you have completed the route!

Now you have two options, continue with the route or rest and finish the route for today.

missions.johnson_valley.aiRace.outbackba: A wasteland race in the Burnside banger race cars.
Pace yourself on this rough outback course, it's going to get dusty!
This demonstration challenge is simple: Arrive at the destination!

Tutorial Challenge:

For your first challenge we're keeping it simple. Your primary goal: Reach the destination!

Keep in mind that this isn't a race, so watch out for obstacles like curbs and barriers – they're unforgiving!

Objectives and their rewards are listed in order of stars in the lower right corner.
missions.utah.timeTrial.rallystage.title: Prospector's Return
missions.utah.timeTrial.rallystage.descr: A technical route that features the mine system.
missions.utah.timeTrial.rallystage.start: This is a long technical stage that takes you through a mine shaft section, watch out for the jump!
missions.east_coast_usa.timeTrial.mixedr: A route with asphalt and gravel road sections.
This long technical stage will test all of your driving skills. Good luck!
missions.johnson_valley.arrive.outlander: Drive the site manager's Roamer back to his cabin without damaging it.

The site manager got a bit excited after a few malt drinks last night and decided to go rock crawling in his wife's Roamer. Luckily, some of the staff managed to get him out of the car before he got it stuck. They got him home to bed and left the Roamer out in the desert. Your job this morning is to get it back to the site manager's house, but do not damage it. Remember, it's his wife's car. You will not be popular if you damage it.
Get as many items to the finish as you can.

How much of the cafe clean up can you take down the mountain in one run? Lets find out. You will have to take the dirt route since the main road down is close at the moment. Get to the entrance of the factory, they will take it from there.
missions.west_coast_usa.delivery.obstruc: Carefully drive through the highly obstructed road with a semi truck.
The road is under heavy work right now, but you need to get the supplies to the hospital as they are refitting. Carefully navigate your way through the road works to the hospital.
missions.west_coast_usa.timeTrial.gearsp: Climb to the top of the hill as fast as you can.
Get to the top of the hill as quickly as you can. You will need to make good use of the gearbox and drivetrain to get the fastest time. The key is to avoid hitting the rev limiter at all times.
missions.west_coast_usa.arrive.Gas.title: Gas Runner
missions.west_coast_usa.arrive.Gas.descr: Deliver some contaminated fuel to the refinery.
missions.west_coast_usa.arrive.Gas.intro: This gas station was given some bad petroleum. It needs taking back to the refinery.
missions.johnson_valley.timeTrial.desert: A fast route across the desert in a rally car.
Keep your foot down and charge to the end of the route, located on the highway.
Deliver the shopfit supplies to the top of the hill.

The cafe on the hill is getting refitted, however the supply company dropped off all the equipment to the factory and left us to finish the delivery. I guess that they couldn't handle the climb. It looks like it's up to you. Drive into the car park on your right and hook up the load, then follow the road to the top of the hill and drop off the supplies to the cafe.
missions.italy.delivery.abseilingfuel.de: Deliver a fuel tanker to the bottom of the mountain.
missions.italy.delivery.abseilingfuel.in: Take the fuel tanker down to the gas station which is situated next to the airport. Take your time with the down hill sections and be sure to make use of your compression braking system. This will stop your drum brakes from overheating and will allow a more controlled way of maintaining your speed. You can take a left or a right at the fork in the road, the choice is yours. Be prepared to mount the curbs on the hairpins so take it steady.
missions.utah.delivery.desertdriver.desc: Deliver a container of engines to the autoshop.
missions.utah.delivery.desertdriver.intr: Your job for today is to deliver a container of engines down to the auto shop by the highway. Leave the Information Center and pickup the container trailer from the dealership which is located down the road. Make your way down the hill being careful not to overspeed. You can use your compression braking system to help control your speed when driving down a slope. The garage would like you to reverse the trailer into the rear carpark when you arrive.
missions.industrial.delivery.shipmentshu: Find all the trailers and park them at the designated area.

Your job for today is to collect the three trailers that are parked around the port. The large white beam will guide you to the location in which we need you to park them. Cruise around the port, find the three trailers and back the them all into the target zone.

missions.jungle_rock_island.timeTrial.Hi: A rough asphalt road to the top of the mountain. You will face sharp turns and dangerous cliffs all around the course.
missions.jungle_rock_island.timeTrial.Mo: An asphalt stage that leads you up one side of the mountain and then down the other.
