missions.west_coast_usa.timeTrial.Highwa: With over ten miles of straights and high-speed sweepers, you'd better bring some tall gears to this circuit.
A race around the highway intersection in poor visibility conditions, combining fast straights and tight corners.
Reach top speed on this one mile long highway strip!
missions.west_coast_usa.timeTrial.Mounta: Drive on the mountain roads of West Coast USA.
Drive the big race track just outside the city.
missions.west_coast_usa.timeTrial.Altern: Drive the alternate layout of the big race track just outside the city.
Drive the short version of the big race track just outside the city.
Drive the big race track just outside the city, with a chicane in the middle of the long straight. Ideal for slower vehicles.
missions.west_coast_usa.timeTrial.OffRoa: This figure-eight dirt track features multiple jumps, rough terrain and uneven ground.
missions.automation_test_track.timeTrial: A circuit around the narrow and technical handling course.
A harrowing ride along the cliffs and around the switchbacks of the mountain. Beware of the icey roads at the top of the mountain.
A twisty climb on gravel roads.
A 7.8KM endurance rally up and down the mountain.
A full circuit around the Automation Test Track.
A short layout around the Automation Test Track.
A circuit using the old race track road, featuring a concrete banked turn.
missions.industrial.timeTrial.Containerl: A very difficult and technical course with a lot of verticality
A challenging lap around the outside of the container area requiring precise driving.
missions.industrial.timeTrial.Figure.des: A gravel and asphalt figure-eight type layout.
A gravel and asphalt layout following the perimeter of the race track.
missions.industrial.timeTrial.Short.desc: A short gravel and asphalt layout.
missions.industrial.timeTrial.Sprint1.de: A long gravel and asphalt layout.
missions.industrial.timeTrial.West.title: West Mixed Circuit
missions.industrial.timeTrial.West.descr: An asphalt only route of the mixed circuit.
missions.industrial.timeTrial.Figure1.de: A figure eight layout in the old industrial area.
missions.industrial.timeTrial.High.title: High Speed Industrial Course
missions.industrial.timeTrial.High.descr: The fastest layout in the industrial area.
missions.industrial.timeTrial.Long.title: Long Industrial Course
missions.industrial.timeTrial.Long.descr: The longest layout in the industrial area.
missions.industrial.timeTrial.Sprint2.de: A short, winding layout in the industrial area.
missions.industrial.timeTrial.Curved.des: The perimeter circuit which incorporates the chicane.
missions.industrial.timeTrial.Long1.desc: The longest layout of the race track which incorporates the inner circuit.
missions.industrial.timeTrial.Perimeter1: A fast layout following the perimeter road of the map.
missions.industrial.timeTrial.West1.desc: A layout on the west portion of the race track.
A technical race through an abandoned industrial complex.
missions.gridmap_v2.timeTrial.Halfpipes1: Slim, straight segments and ramps make this difficult course perfect for vehicles with good handling and strong acceleration.
missions.gridmap_v2.timeTrial.Halfpipes2: Swing back and forth in this short, but challenging track.
missions.gridmap_v2.timeTrial.Halfpipes3: Don't get dizzy in this loopy track below the map.
missions.gridmap_v2.timeTrial.Highspeed1: Select the fastest vehicle you can and race around the whole map on this long track with lots of banked turns.
missions.gridmap_v2.timeTrial.Highspeed2: Get to top speeds on this short oval track.
missions.gridmap_v2.timeTrial.Easy.title: Easy Skycurve
missions.gridmap_v2.timeTrial.Easy.descr: Enjoy the scenery while swaying through the gentle curves of this track.
missions.gridmap_v2.timeTrial.Fast.title: Fast Skycurve
missions.gridmap_v2.timeTrial.Fast.descr: Make sure to not fall off the track when trying this difficult, fast-paced skycurve.
missions.gridmap_v2.timeTrial.Medium.des: Race through the loop on this medium difficulty skycurve.
missions.east_coast_usa.timeTrial.Backro: A long course of mixed dirt and asphalt roads. It's best to choose a vehicle that is at home with both surfaces.
missions.east_coast_usa.timeTrial.Defore: A short dirt stage in the deforested area of the map. Watch out for fallen trees and stumps on the roadside.
missions.east_coast_usa.timeTrial.High.d: A loop made of straight road sections allowing for very high speeds. Brake heavily before the corners to avoid flying off of the road.
missions.east_coast_usa.timeTrial.Offroa: A narrow trail through dirt, gravel, rocks and boulders. A good place to take a vehicle with four wheel drive and decent ground clearance.
missions.east_coast_usa.timeTrial.Asphal: An asphalt stage on countryside roads. Suitable for a variety of vehicles.
An asphalt stage on countryside roads. Suitable for a variety of vehicles.
missions.east_coast_usa.timeTrial.Sawmil: Short course through the sawmill dirty paths.
Long course through the sawmill dirty paths.
A short street stage winding through the town. The stage contains sharp corners and shortcuts over the pavement.
A short street course winding through the town. Be sure to not hit the traffic barrels!
missions.derby.timeTrial.Oval.title: Dirt oval
missions.derby.timeTrial.Big.title: The Big 8
missions.derby.timeTrial.Big.description: A fast track with banked turns and two jumps. Recommended jump speed is 100km/h. Powerful cars with soft suspensions are advised.
missions.small_island.timeTrial.IRS1.des: This short stage runs over unmaintained asphalt and gravel roads.
missions.small_island.timeTrial.IRS2.des: This long stage runs over asphalt, gravel, and some beach sand.
missions.small_island.timeTrial.IRS3.des: This very long stage will challenge you with narrow dirt roads over the rocky center of the island.
A course around the island perimeter road.
An alternative route around the island perimeter road. Beware, this route contians a tricky offroad jump section. Make sure that you have a vehicle that can handle some air and heavy landings.
missions.small_island.timeTrial.mountain: This track leads you up and down the mountain. Expect tricky rocks and steep slopes!
missions.utah.timeTrial.Asphalt.title: Asphalt Hillclimb
missions.utah.timeTrial.Asphalt.descript: A fast-paced asphalt climb to the top of the mesa.
missions.utah.timeTrial.Mixed.title: Road Course 1
missions.utah.timeTrial.Mixed.descriptio: A course is composed of a 2-lane highway and narrow asphalt backroads. Suitable for a variety of vehicles.
missions.utah.timeTrial.Canyon.title: Mixed Stage 1
missions.utah.timeTrial.Canyon.descripti: This stage begins on narrow canyonside roads, then descends to a dirt section, with a final stretch on the highway.
missions.utah.timeTrial.Dead.title: Dead Man's Loop
missions.utah.timeTrial.Dead.description: A mostly gravel loop along some dangerous cliffs.
missions.utah.timeTrial.Old.title: Old Mill Loop
missions.utah.timeTrial.Old.description: A Gravel loop around mesas and canyons, starting at the old mill.
missions.utah.timeTrial.River.title: River Route
missions.utah.timeTrial.River.descriptio: A fast-paced route along the river featuring many water crossings.
missions.industrial.timeTrial.PortTT.des: A tight time trial around the port.
missions.industrial.timeTrial.PortTT.sta: Keep on your toes for this technical course through the port.
missions.west_coast_usa.collection.downt: Collect all the cash bags from around the downtown area.
Grab all the cash bags from around the city. Lookout for the hidden ones in a couple of spots.
missions.derby.aiRace.Flag.title: Flag Pole Derby
missions.derby.aiRace.Flag.description: An oval race with an inloop.
missions.utah.collection.G500Campsite.de: Collect the items across the desert from the camp site.
missions.utah.collection.G500Campsite.in: After a mass trash bagging around the site, the bags need collecting quickly before the coach of campers arrive.
missions.utah.timeTrial.G500Gambler.desc: A timed circuit race on mixed surfaces.
missions.utah.timeTrial.G500Gambler.star: In this timed run you will need to make two laps of the circuit. There is a section of fast asphalt, so prepare for some varied traction.
missions.small_island.collection.G500Pol: A technical collection of trash bags at the port.
The port has been hand cleaned and the bags are ready to assemble. Hurry though, there is a boat show starting here at any moment.
missions.industrial.timeTrial.G500Catwal: A technical time trial circuit with a twist, tight turns and a jump.
Will you take on the catwalk? This course will take you through the tank farm without ease.
missions.small_island.timeTrial.G500Gamb: Two laps of the inner loop here on the island is the order of the day. Maintaining speed as much as possible will be imperative to a good result.
A high speed collection, spanned over two neighboring race tracks.
A large track invasion after the glorious victory of a local driver has left the whole facility in a mess. Now that everything is bagged, we need it cleared before today's operations begin.
missions.small_island.delivery.G500Wreck: Deliver the abandoned Covet to the port.

This thing has been sitting up here for seven years now. It's high time that it was dealt with. Start the car, then park it so the tow hitch is close to the trailer hitch. Get out and activate the tow hitch trigger to connect the trailer.

Take the wreck to the port where it will be shipped off the island and sent to a scrap yard for recycling. Carefully traverse the hill and bring the trailer and wreck into the port drop-off area to finish the delivery.
Get out of the car and activate the tow hitch trigger to connect the trailer.
missions.east_coast_usa.timeTrial.G500Cu: A short, technical run through the woods in the Poogeon.
This run will give you wings, if you are brave enough.
missions.small_island.timeTrial.G500Roug: A short, technical and rocky hotlap spot.
Although not long, this route will fight back if you aren't prepared for some tight gaps and large bumps.
missions.small_island.scatterPickup.G500: Pick up trash that's been left over the island.

Oh no! The island is full of trash. Thankfully, volunteers have already gathered most of it and put it on big piles so it's easier to transport. Drive around and fill your vehicle up with trash as quickly as possible!
missions.east_coast_usa.scatterPickup.G5: The town has just had a large festival and now that it's over. There is a great deal of trash to deal with. Do what you can.
missions.johnson_valley.timeTrial.G500Tr: A timed run on the short course circuit.
Take the vehicle to edge of traction to get it around the course as fast as you can.
missions.industrial.delivery.G500Motor.d: Deliver a dangerous load of junk.
missions.industrial.delivery.G500Motor.i: A lot of old parts were found at the Container Land zone. Get as much of it to the port as you can.
missions.johnson_valley.scatterPickup.G5: Gather old debris from the desert.
It's been a long time since anyone cleared up out there. People have been seen tipping their old building scrap and general trash in various places near this settlement. Gather as much as you can.
missions.johnson_valley.timeTrial.G500To: A long stage on the toughest roads of the desert.
This route will be very tough on the car. A mix of focus and mechanical sympathy will be important here.
missions.jungle_rock_island.timeTrial.G5: Get to the bottom of the muddy slope.
This stage is not for the faint of heart. Wrestle the Covet to the bottom of the hill on very slippery roads.
missions.jungle_rock_island.aiRace.G500j: An end to end race through tough jungle terrain.
Battle your way through the jungle and down the beach.
missions.jungle_rock_island.timeTrial.G5: A rough road with the Poogeon.
Rocks, mud and trees make this route very technical. Carrying speed is the key to a good time.
missions.jungle_rock_island.delivery.G50: Deliver a bunch of old engines.

We found these old engines down in the viaduct. The team at the airfield want a crack at getting them going again for some kind of crafts they are building. Get them over there without losing them. Chop chop, you are late!
missions.west_coast_usa.timeTrial.Spearl: A route around the outside of Spearleaf Island.
Keep your speed up for this technical ring road.
missions.west_coast_usa.collection.Stole: Collect all the steel parts from around the foundry.
Collect all of the steel parts!
missions.west_coast_usa.collection.speed: Speed through downtown Belasco City and collect as many markers as you can!
Collect markers at the downtown intersections before time runs out. Drive fast, but watch out for traffic!
missions.italy.delivery.Dock.title: Dock Duty
missions.italy.delivery.Dock.description: Find all of the trailers around the port and park them on the Dock.
missions.italy.delivery.Dock.introMessag: Take the MD tractor unit and locate the container trailers that are parked on the dock. Once you have located one, hitch up and bring it to the first dock. You may have to reverse some of the trailers to the target zone in order to get back off of the dock.
missions.heistM.italy.title: Il furto di Castelleto
missions.heistM.italy.description: Prepare and carry out a heist mission in one of the spots marked. Steal a vehicle, go to the marked spot and escape.
missions.heistM.italy.startDescription:
Prepare and carry out a robbery in one of the points marked by the bosses in this level.
Steal a vehicle located near the start, go to the marked place
 where the robbery will take place and escape to the place marked as the escape point.
 Throughout the mission you will be a suspect for the police,
 so try to be as discreet as possible or evade the police before continuing with the mission
missions.heistM.attemptDescription:
This is the summary of the mission lads.

 -Steal the marked vehicle at {{start}}, we will use that for the heist.
 -Drive to the heist spot at {{heist}}.
 -If the heist goes wrong, escape from the police and reach the escape point at {{escape}}.
 Try to avoid the police as much as possible, if they see us we will have to loose them before continue with the plan.
missions.heistM.endTitle: The heist has been a success!
missions.heistM.failTitle: The police have managed to stop the heist.
missions.heistM.goto: Find a place to wait until the heist is complete.
missions.heistM.findPlace: Find a place to wait until the heist is complete.
missions.heistM.wait: Wait until the heist is done.
missions.heistM.greatHeist: The heist has been a success, time to go to the meeting point.
missions.heistM.badHeist: The heist has been a failure, the police are on their way, loose them and then go to the meeting point.
missions.heistM.descriptionAbandon: Do you want to abandon the mission?
missions.driver_training.training_beginn: The start of the Driver Training Campaign. Simply drive a short distance.

Welcome to the ETK Driver Experience Center. Let's start out nice and easy - all you have to do is drive over to the other parking spot and stop there.
Be gentle with the throttle and slow down a bit before you turn.
Looks like you know the very basics already. Lets get to some cornering next.
missions.driver_training.training_accele: Accelerate and come to a full stop.

For this challenge, you have accelerate, and then stop before you hit the barriers. Make sure you accelerate and brake hard, because the time limit is pretty tight with this one. Brake when you reach the stop signs!
So you can drive like a pro in a straight line? Good for you!
Too slow! You'll actually have to use your accelerator pedal for this test.
Where are you going? The test area is in the other direction!
That'll buff out. Give it another try and please be more careful!
missions.driver_training.training_corner: In the unlikely event that the road is not straight, you may need to stop accelerating and use your vehicle's steering wheel. [br][br]Try it here on the roundabout, but watch out for the slippery area.
Nice turn. It's time to get you onto a proper road now.
I want to see you drive faster than that.
Looks like you might be running wide on the turn. Take it slower if you need to.
Staying off the grass would be a good start.
missions.driver_training.training_tightr: A tight wavy road. Don't cut corners!
Next up there will be a few more turns, on a narrow road. Try to find the proper speed for those tight corners. Again, try to slow down going into a corner. Don't hit any pylons!
Good job! I think it's time to make you drive a real vehicle.
If you're going to travel that slow, I don't think a vehicle is even necessary.
You hit a marker - I put them there to stop you cutting corners, you know.
The roads aren't a suggestion, buddy!
missions.driver_training.training_lanech: Changing lanes at highway speeds requires a gentle hand on the steering wheel. Be careful - you need to accelerate quickly and drive fast, but the road is very narrow. Make sure to not hit any cones. Do you have what it takes to control an 80s supercar?
Well done! The Civetta Bolide can be a tricky vehicle for beginners.
You're supposed to be driving at highway speeds, aren't you?
I see a cone knocked over... that means you went outside the track!
Our insurance isn't going to be happy about this.
missions.driver_training.training_corner: Learn about appropriate speeds for curves.
You can't take just any corner at any speed: stick to the speed limits on the signs to guarantee your success.
Good job! I see you've grasped the concept of managing speed while cornering.
Looks like you're driving a lot slower than what your vehicle is capable of.
You hit a cone. Try to stay inside the rumble strips.
Cars tend to corner worse after they've been smashed against walls.
missions.driver_training.training_easyci: I've set up a circuit for you to practice what you've learned. It should be pretty easy: 2 laps, no surprises.
Well done! You've passed the basic component of this course. Now we can move on to some more advanced driving techniques. There's a bunch of different courses you can try around the map now.
That's a bit too slow - don't be afraid to push the vehicle more!
You hit a cone, precision is key in racing. Try again.
This vehicle is going to need some repair work.
missions.driver_training.training_hairpi: Turn your vehicle around quickly in limited space.
How do you turn the vehicle around quickly in a tiny space? Pull the handbrake to slide round a hairpin, just like in the movies.
I've got to admit, that looked pretty cool.
Time's up! You'll have to finish quicker than that.
You didn't quite make that turn cleanly - I see you've bumped an obstacle.
Hmm, do we need to go back to lesson one?
missions.driver_training.training_slalom: A slalom course is a hard thing to master. Get a feel for the weight of the vehicle as you weave between the cones
Well done! You dodged those cones like a pro.
Too slow! A slalom course is only challenging at speed.
You bumped a cone back there, have another try.
Guess I should have set the barriers up further away!
missions.driver_training.training_rwd.in: The Bruckell Moonhawk handles like a boat, so if you can finish a lap of this circuit first try, you're doing better than most of my students.
missions.driver_training.training_rwd.de: Great job! You are really getting the hang of this.
missions.driver_training.training_rwd.no: Watch those cones! Remember this vehicle doesn't quite handle as well as some of the others you've driven.
missions.driver_training.training_rwd.ti: This vehicle has a V8 engine with plenty of power... use it!
missions.driver_training.training_rwd.da: This vehicle is definitely going to need some work done before it's drivable again.
missions.driver_training.training_advanc: You made that last course look too easy, so I've set up a circuit with four of the most difficult turns I could think of. Good luck, you're going to need it!
I'm amazed that you did it! Now let's finish off this training course with something fun.
Not fast enough - I know you can do better than that.
You hit a cone - if you're skidding off of the track, try reducing your speed on corner entry.
Nasty crash there, are you okay? Looks like the vehicle's out of action.
missions.driver_training.diffs.title: Differentials
missions.driver_training.diffs.descripti: Learn how to get up steep terrain.
missions.driver_training.diffs.intro:
Try to climb over the obstacles that are made from concrete pipes. To get over them, you can lock the front and rear differentials. This will force the left and right wheels to rotate at the same speed, letting each wheel apply as much rotational force as the traction under it will allow.
Additionally, you will want to set your rangebox to low mode, giving you a lot more torque on the driveshaft, but lower top speeds.
missions.driver_training.diffs.defaultWi: Great job! Always remember to set up your vehicle to the task at hand.
missions.driver_training.diffs.timeLimit: Not fast enough - Try to use the throttle gently so you don't bounce all over the place.
missions.driver_training.wetcorner.title: Wet Corner
missions.driver_training.wetcorner.descr: Experience Anti-Lock-Braking and Electronic Stability Control on wet surfaces.
missions.driver_training.wetcorner.intro:
Drive along the course with your right hand wheels on the slippery surface and your left wheels on the dry surface. Try to stay centered and don't hit any cones!
You will notice that even when braking slightly, the vehicle will not spin out - the anti-lock braking system (ABS) is kicking in and stopping the wheels from locking completely. It is also visible in the tacho ui.
You can also try switching off your electronic stability control (ESC) - it also supports your vehicle in not spinning out.
missions.driver_training.wetcorner.defau: Great job! Always remember to set up your vehicle to the task at hand.
missions.driver_training.wetcorner.timeL: Not fast enough - Try to use the throttle gently to keep a smooth turn.
missions.driver_training.wetcorner.nomov: You hit a cone - if you're skidding off the track, try reducing your speed and braking very softly.
missions.driver_training.drift001.title: Gymkhana Test Course
missions.driver_training.drift001.descri: Learn how to do simple drifts.
missions.driver_training.drift001.intro:
In this short drift training exercise, you will need to do one perpendicular drift and one donut. Then drive through the goal, all within 20 seconds.
Tips:
  • Accelerate strongly and use the handbrake briefly. Then turn right or left to get your vehicle to rotate.
  • Use throttle and steering while sliding to adjust the angle of your vehicle.
  • Gain at least 2300 points for the gold medal.
Good Luck!
missions.driver_training.drift001.wood: Drifting is difficult. It's all a matter of knowing when to use the handbrake, when to release it. The same goes for pedal control.
missions.driver_training.drift001.bronze: You are going somewhere. Try getting a tighter donut and a tighter angle in general.
missions.driver_training.drift001.silver: It seems like you know the basics. Now it's only a matter of attempting again.
missions.driver_training.drift001.gold: That was perfect! Now you are ready to practice on narrower, more difficult roads.
missions.driver_training.drift002.title: Freeform Gymkhana
missions.driver_training.drift002.descri: The perfect playground for drifting. A big clear area, no risks, only fun. You should experiment with different types of vehicles in order to learn how each one of them handles.
missions.driver_training.drift002.win: There's no loser here. We're here to train, to experiment and get better.
scenarios.east_coast_usa.gm_racetest.des: A short series of small jumps
scenarios.east_coast_usa.tanker_delivery: Deliver a tanker trailer with your Gavril T-Series to the garage on the other side of town.
scenarios.east_coast_usa.police_patrol.d: Stop the speeding Hirochi SBR4 with your much slower Gavril Roamer Sheriff Edition.
scenarios.east_coast_usa.hidden_jump_a.d: Master a hidden jump through the trees in a Gavril Roamer. Careful control of speed and placement is required to survive the jump and make it to the checkpoint.
Use your Gavril T-Series to deliver a couple of valuable classic supercars to a house in the town. Whatever you do, don't damage the vehicles.
scenarios.east_coast_usa.deliverytruck_t: Stop the fleeing delivery truck in your Gavril Grand Marshal police car!
You got too far away from the suspect
scenarios.east_coast_usa.pessima_test.de: A fun time trial to introduce the 1996 Ibishu Pessima.
scenarios.east_coast_usa.destroy_the_car: Destroy the Bruckell Moonhawk, no matter what it takes.
scenarios.east_coast_usa.minimum_speed.d: Use your old and broken Gavril T-Series to deliver some concrete for the very last time.
scenarios.east_coast_usa.bank_robbery.de: You got a report about a bank robbery in your local town. Respond to the report and stop the fleeing suspect before he reaches his hideout.
scenarios.east_coast_usa.bank_robbery.lo: You got lost on the way to the bank
scenarios.east_coast_usa.intro_road_race: A race through the countryside on east coast of the United States.
scenarios.east_coast_usa.offroad_ds_cour: Narrow bumpy track progressing in difficulty.
scenarios.east_coast_usa.town_course_sho: Another short sprint around the town.
scenarios.east_coast_usa.east_coast_chas:
A wanted individual has been spotted near the sawmill in a Gavril Barstow.

Drive to the location, and stop it!
The fugitive got too far, you lost them..
Your vehicle is nearly totaled, it cannot continue the chase..
Somebody just robbed the local gas station. Witnesses say they were seen leaving in a Soliad Wendover. Find and arrest them!
Your vehicle has received too much damage, it cannot continue the chase..
All of this for stealing a bag of chips..
We received reports of a reckless driver in a custom Bruckell Legran. Stop it!
The Legran got too far, you lost it..
Your vehicle has received too much damage, it cannot continue the chase..
Good job, one less reckless driver on the roads
BeamCom still hasn't fixed the internet at the police station. No more waiting on hold, it's time to convince them in person. Stop the van.
The van got too far, you lost it..
Your vehicle has received too much damage..
Your vehicle is trashed, and our internet is still not working!
Well done, hopefully they do something more than turning off and on the modem!
scenarios.east_coast_usa.jump_course.des:
Gavril Motors has sponsored a stunt driving event to showcase the strength of their new D25 model.

Stunt jumps have been placed along the course. You will be given points the bigger your jumps will be. You have no time limit, but try to keep the pace up!
scenarios.east_coast_usa.jump_course.gol: Your run has been exceptional, and you also got maximum score for those jumps! Well done!
scenarios.east_coast_usa.jump_course.sil: Nice driving, although you did not reach the target score for those jumps.
scenarios.east_coast_usa.high_speed_high: Blast through the rural highways in a twin turbo monster.
scenarios.east_coast_usa.rallycross_nd_l: A Rallycross course with a mix of asphalt and dirty roads.
scenarios.east_coast_usa.town_course_sho: A short sprint around the town.
scenarios.east_coast_usa.intro_road_race: A race through the countryside of the east coast of the United States.
scenarios.east_coast_usa.car_delivery.de: You've got an expensive sports car loaded up on your Gavril T-Series, take it to the new owner in the countryside.
scenarios.east_coast_usa.dirt_hopper.des: A short dirt time trial to introduce the Ibishu Hopper.
scenarios.gridmap.slalom.title: Slalom Trial
scenarios.gridmap.slalom.description: Weave back and forth between the blocks in an Ibishu Covet. Keep the speed steady and manage the cars balance with steering and throttle.
scenarios.gridmap.corridor.title: Corridor
scenarios.gridmap.corridor.description: A truck is heading your way, and your little Ibishu Pigeon is trapped in a small corridor. Find a way to survive!
scenarios.gridmap.gm_racetest.title: Gridmap Quickrace Test
scenarios.gridmap.gm_racetest.descriptio: A short series of small jumps.
scenarios.gridmap.gm_jumps.title: Jump Trial
scenarios.gridmap.gm_jumps.description: This trial sends you over a series of small jumps in an Ibishu Covet. The right speed makes all the difference.
scenarios.gridmap.hard_parking.title: Hard Parking
scenarios.gridmap.hard_parking.descripti: Parallel park as quickly as possible by sliding between two cars.
scenarios.gridmap.gm_skycurve1.title: Sky Curve 1
scenarios.gridmap.gm_skycurve1.descripti: Drive a Hirochi Sunburst RS on Sky Curve!
scenarios.gridmap.gm_ds_offroad_shortcou: 3 sets of off-road challenges, can the Gavril D15 take it?
scenarios.gridmap.gm_ds_large_jumps.desc: Take an off-road spec Gavril H15 for one hell of a ride.
scenarios.gridmap.gm_suspension_race.des: This trial leads you back and forth over the 4 different suspension test patterns in a Gavril Roamer. It's a great way to ruin the alignment.
scenarios.gridmap.gm_intersection_1.desc: Calibrate your speed in the tunnel and try to hit the other vehicle as it crosses the exit.
scenarios.gridmap.gm_skycurve2.title: Sky Curve 2
scenarios.gridmap.gm_skycurve2.descripti: Drive a Civetta Bolide 390GTR on Sky Curve 2!
scenarios.gridmap.gm_intersection_2.desc: Calibrate your speed and try to hit the other vehicle. This time with a twist!
scenarios.gridmap.fg-bowling.title: Bowling
scenarios.gridmap.fg-bowling.description: Play a round of bowling with the Pigeon.
scenarios.gridmap.fg-bowling.intro: Welcome to bowling with the Pigeon! You have 5 tries to knock over as many barrels as you can. Pressing the start button below will load the Pigeon and the pins, which will take a short amount of time. Have fun!
scenarios.gridmap.fg-bowling.forfeit: Press Reset ([action=reset_physics]) again to forfeit this attempt.
scenarios.gridmap.fg-bowling.restart: Press Reset ([action=reset_physics]) to start another round.
scenarios.gridmapv2.mountain.title: Collect Mountain
scenarios.gridmapv2.mountain.shortDesc: Collect 15 markers with a Hopper. Use as few resets as possible for the highest score!
scenarios.gridmapv2.mountain.desc:
Collect all 15 markers on the mountain! You can use reset[action=reset_physics] to the last marker you collected. Use as few resets as possible to get the highest score:
  • 0 resets: Gold
  • 5 or less resets: Silver
  • 20 or less resets: Bronze
Tips:
  • There are multiple paths you can take.
  • It can help to switch the rangebox or differentials to clear some paths more easily.
  • Take it slow and keep an eye on the pitch and roll apps.
  • You can pause the simulation using [action=pause] to check out the marker positions.
Good luck!
scenarios.gridmapv2.mountain.resultGold: You did it! You collected all markers without a single reset. You are surely a master of the Hopper. Well done!
scenarios.gridmapv2.mountain.resultSilve: You did it! You collected all markers, while only using very few resets. You seem to be pretty experienced with the hopper already. Well done!
scenarios.gridmapv2.mountain.resultBronz: You did it! Even after using a handful of resets, you managed to collect all markers. Well done!
scenarios.gridmapv2.mountain.resultWood: You did it! You used a lot of retries, but still made it to the top, which is by itself already very difficult. Well done!
missions.jungle_rock_island.rallyStage.p: Unique and scenic gravel sprint through the jungle, with mud and jumps to throw you into the bushes.

Brace yourself for a relentless jungle challenge where every inch of road tests your nerve. With unpredictable bumps and slippery mud patches waiting around each turn, it’s clear that caution and control come before outright speed. One false move, and the dense foliage will claim you—stay focused and manage your risks wisely!
missions.italy.rallyStage.norte.title: SS Fastello-Norte
missions.italy.rallyStage.norte.descript: Fast and fun Italian tarmac stage. Beautiful coastal views if you're able to take your eyes off the road.
missions.italy.rallyStage.norte.startScr: Hit the tarmac in Fastello’s lively streets, then follow the asphalt toward a breathtaking coastal stretch. Mastering the racing line is everything here, especially where crafty local knowledge can shave precious seconds. Keep your foot down in the final dash, and savor the rush of unbridled speed!
missions.italy.rallyLoop.ngrc2025.startS: [Duration: 30-45min] This rally loop aims to immerse you in a realistic rally experience: Start at the service park and drive three stages without repairs, navigate public roads and respect speed limits during liaisons, bring your Time Card to marshalls on time, and most importantly: demonstrate you can handle the pressure of driving fast without crashing.
missions.italy.rallyLoop.ngrc2025.endScr: Congratulations on completing the NGRC Rally Norte 2025!
missions.automation_test_track.rallyStag: Short hillclimb-style tarmac stage with many hairpins and ice in the higher elevations.

Buckle up for a frosty ascent toward the dam, where winter roads and snowdrifts are only half the battle. Brave the gutters to shave off crucial seconds—but one miscalculation could leave your running gear in tatters. Stay sharp and keep the car on a knife’s edge!
Technical tarmac stage that will test your handbrake abilities with a small amount of gravel in the beginning.

Buckle up and get ready for a blend of surfaces right from the start! You’ll kick off on a short gravel stretch from the airport service road, then cruise across the apron’s smooth asphalt. After that, it’s on to the Automation Test Track, where most of the real challenges await. Keep an eye out for two additional gravel segments along the way—they’re sure to put your driving skills to the test!
Starts and ends on coastal tarmac, with a technical gravel up-and-down middle section.

Ready for some off-road action? Navigate sharp corners and rough patches as you dash across rock-strewn terrain. Keep the throttle steady, keep your eyes peeled, and remember—precision is key when every inch of road fights back!
missions.utah.rallyStage.prospectorsretu: Get ready for a dust-churning dash across Utah’s rugged terrain, culminating in a plunge through the old mining tunnel. Bright desert skies give way to near darkness in an instant, demanding quick reactions and a steady hand on the wheel. Navigate the jagged walls and uneven ground—one lapse, and you might not see daylight again

Ready to face Utah’s depths? Tackle twisting canyon roads before diving headlong into the claustrophobic confines of a long-abandoned tunnel. Keep your eyes sharp and your speed in check—the sudden shift from open desert to dimly lit rock corridors will test every ounce of your driving skill. Good luck!
missions.small_island.delivery.vintageha: Deliver the load of logs and parts to the Research Center.

Take the load of logs to the Research Center, but pick up the trailer from the hill on the way. Start the car, then park it so the tow hitch is close to the trailer hitch. Get out and activate the tow hitch trigger to connect the trailer.

Drive carefully though, since this amount of weight will be a struggle for the old Nine. It's a cold foggy morning, so keep your wits about you and bring the trailer into the research station drop-off area to finish the delivery.
missions.derby.aiRace.Guttered.title: Guttered
missions.derby.aiRace.Guttered.descripti: Duke it out in the muddy depths of the sumo gutter.
missions.derby.aiRace.Guttered.startText: Race against tough opponents in the gutter of the sumo pit!
missions.utah.chase.moonshinerunner.desc: Chase down the bootlegger and recover the stash!
missions.utah.chase.moonshinerunner.star: A bootlegger thought we were clueless about their stash location. We just had to bide our time until they showed up with the goods, and now’s the moment to strike. Try to keep their vehicle intact as there might be more evidence inside.
missions.east_coast_usa.aiRace.hotrodclu: Race in the Hotrod Club event on a technical street course.
Take on the club members on this technical street course.  Be prepared for tight turns and high speed!
missions.johnson_valley.timeTrial.Aurata: You are invited to test out the Aurata on a tough trail.
Attempt to successfully navigate this Sports Turbo spec Aurata UTV to the trail's end. Take special care in the middle section of the trial. For an added challenge, try out the reverse configuration.
missions.west_coast_usa.collection.Super: Race down the highway collecting markers.
Get to the end grabbing as many markers as you can before the timer runs out!
missions.jungle_rock_island.timeTrial.Mu: A long and very muddy trail in the Wild Aurata.
Is mud your thing? This long, challenging trail in the Aurata may change your mind.
missions.automation_test_track.collectio: Collect the goodies from the dark woods.
If you go into the woods today, you may find and array of surprises. Retrieve as many of the BeamNG markers from the woods as you can.
missions.automation_test_track.timeTrial: A mixed surface route through the lower parts of the map.
This route will test the most dedicated of drivers. Taking advantage of the great features on this map, this route is fast, tight and full of danger.
missions.automation_test_track.aiRace.ma: A Race around the main course in performance matched vehicles.
Take on a field of vehicles which match the performance class of your player vehicle.
missions.automation_test_track.collectio: Retrieve all of the engine parts that have been left around the grounds by a failed burglary.
missions.automation_test_track.crawl.cli: Can you make this trail to the top?

Your goal is to reach the end of the crawling course. If you leave the area for more than five seconds, you will fail the mission.
Reaching a [color=#ffff00][b]yellow checkpoint[/b][/color] will create a new recovery position. Use [action=reset_physics] or the Menu to recover to your latest recovery position. You can restart the mission by resetting again after recovery, or using the Menu.
missions.automation_test_track.timeTrial: Take on this technical hill top test track.
missions.johnson_valley.crawl.Van.title: Van der Waals' Vertigo
missions.johnson_valley.crawl.Van.descri: A tough crawl trail in a very capable offroader. Can you make the Gecko stick?
missions.johnson_valley.crawl.Van.startS: Take this route to the top and back. Try to keep it on all four wheels!
missions.johnson_valley.crawl.Bootlegger: A tough, long crawl to a disclosed location.
Take the old smugglers route to the stash, or can you?
missions.johnson_valley.crawl.Out.title: Out of Scale
missions.johnson_valley.crawl.Out.startS: Follow the route up the steep face. Keep your whits about you in case the vehicle rolls over backwards.
missions.johnson_valley.crawl.Ridgeway.d: A crawl on the edge of comfort.
missions.johnson_valley.crawl.Ridgeway.s: Take the rocky ridge to the top for a glorious view.
missions.johnson_valley.crawl.Rinky.star: Take this crawler's introduction trail to get a brief feel for what crawling is all about on this kind of terrain.
Cross the shrublands and the desert to get to the fuel station.

A lenient course across the shrublands. Keep on the dirt. Crossing the posts will cause you to go out of bounds. Make your way to the fuel station at the far side of the map. Drive carefully, the hills and shrubs can throw your vehicle out of balance or slow you down.
Cross the whole map - dunes, hills and shrublands.

A moderate course across the map. Keep inside the zone and drive all the way across the desert, hills and shrublands to the other side. Drive carefully, the distance can be deceiving - it's much further than you may think!
Find your own way across the mountains.
This freeform crawl will force you to scale the toughest cut through the mountains of Johnson Valley. Keep inside the zone and plan your route carefully!
Collect all the crates in the camp.
Collect all the crates in the camp as quickly as possible!
missions.johnson_valley.collection.Rocks: Collect all the markers on the hill as carefully as possible!
Collect the markers using as few recoveries as possible. Don't forget to keep your differentials locked and low range gear engaged to help you traverse the terrain.
missions.johnson_valley.collection.Mojav: Collect all the markers before the timer runs out! This is a long expedition of a mission that tours the entire map.

As a new recruit for the local emergency response team, you must pass the vehicle training exercise. Traverse the area in search of the markers. Be careful when you advance through the larger rocks; the fire truck may be powerful, but it is also very heavy.
missions.johnson_valley.collection.Dusty: Collect all the markers as fast as possible.
This quick-fire desert collection challenge will test your maneuverability skills.
missions.johnson_valley.collection.Fortu: Collect the gold from the hills.
Scour the valleys for markers and try to get them all without running out of recoveries. Do not forget to keep your differential locks and low range gear engaged to help you traverse the terrain.
Grab all of the fuel cans as fast as you can.

The new employee at the race course forgot to tie down a load of fuel cans, they were tossed out of his truck and strewn around this area. The employees only noticed the mistake once they got back to the race location. Luckily, someone else saw it happening from a distance and called it in. The worst part is, the fuel was being delivered for a race that is starting in the next hour! We need that fuel collected quickly so that it can be lifted over to the race in time! Good luck and get a move on!
missions.johnson_valley.chase.chase1.sta: There has been a report of someone rooting through the remote pit station.  Go check it out.
missions.johnson_valley.aiRace.smallshor: Race the AI on the small config of the short course.
missions.johnson_valley.aiRace.bigshortc: We're ready to start the race!
missions.johnson_valley.aiRace.race1.des: Last one back to the paddock has to buy the food!
missions.johnson_valley.aiRace.race1.sta: The gang wants to race back to the paddock. Apparently, last one back has to buy the chili dogs.
missions.johnson_valley.hypermiling.midd: Can you get the worker's truck out of trouble?
One of the race marshals ran out of fuel while working far off the main road. You have only brought enough fuel to make it a short distance. Can you help?
missions.johnson_valley.timeTrial.Shortc: Small config of the short course.
Get ready for the short course track!
Alternate small config of the short course.
Take on the alternate small config of the short course.
Large config of the short course.
Take on the large config of the short course track.
missions.johnson_valley.timeTrial.enduro: Can you survive the deep desert?
Take the ring road around the Johnson Valley area. You will need to traverse the desert, but you will not encounter many rocks in that area.
missions.johnson_valley.timeTrial.Broken: A high-speed blast down the main road.
Make a high-speed run down the main road.
missions.johnson_valley.timeTrial.rally1: Take this fearsome route to the center of the map and back. You will need some serious kit if you want to achieve a respectable time.

Calamity Peak is a treacherous mountain, but that doesn't mean it can't be conquered! Weave your way through exhilarating desert race track around the mountain and get to the checkpoints as quickly as you can.
missions.johnson_valley.timeTrial.dunera: Find your way to the checkpoints in the dunes as fast as you can!
Run this open desert event where you just need to get to the checkpoints as fast as you can, with no set route.
missions.johnson_valley.aiRace.baja1.des: Show the locals how it's done!
missions.johnson_valley.aiRace.baja1.sta: The locals like this spot for baja style sprint racing. Show them how it's done!
missions.johnson_valley.timeTrial.rally2: A high speed offroad time trail with a long straight and technical sections.
Can you handle the speed of this course? Of course you can!
missions.italy.aiRace.quarryRace.title: Worksite Wheeler
missions.italy.aiRace.quarryRace.descrip: Race work trucks around the quarry circuit.
missions.italy.aiRace.quarryRace.startTe: Some of the other site workers have arranged a race around the yard. Can you beat them without destroying your truck?
missions.italy.aiRace.quarrycapers.title: Quarry Capers
missions.italy.aiRace.quarrycapers.descr: Race in small rally cars around the quarry loop.
missions.italy.aiRace.quarrycapers.start: This large lap along the coastal road and through the quarry is a real test for you and your opponents.
missions.italy.delivery.marbleHaul1.desc: Drive the haul truck loaded with two marble blocks to the main cutting area of the quarry.
missions.italy.delivery.marbleHaul1.intr:
Get this load to the main cutting area for treatment.
Tip: Use the hill assist to help with a careful, controlled descent.
missions.italy.delivery.blockTruck1.desc: Ferry marble site trailers with a T-Series truck.
missions.italy.delivery.blockTruck1.intr: Take an empty trailer up to the cutting point and leave it with them. Then, bring back a loaded trailer to the finishing zone and park it under the loading gantry.
missions.italy.delivery.blockTruck2.desc: Take a marble load to the finishing zone via the switchback hill and coastal road.
missions.italy.delivery.blockTruck2.intr: Drive to the loaded trailer and hook up.  Then follow the route down the switchbacks and onto the coastal road, remember to use the Compression Brake to control your speed when driving down the hills.  Drive around to the finishing area and park the loaded trailer under the gantry loading spot.
missions.italy.timeTrial.quarrytt1.title: Quarry Loop
missions.italy.timeTrial.quarrytt1.descr: A lap around the quarry and coastal road.
missions.italy.timeTrial.quarrytt1.start: How fast can you lap the quarry?
missions.gridmapv2.climbforlife.title: A Climb For Life
missions.gridmapv2.climbforlife.descript: To arrive up the hill, a sturdy machine is a must. Grab a four wheel-drive and heavy vehicle because there is no way to avoid all of the falling debris
missions.gridmapv2.climbforlife.startScr: Drive up the hill and avoid as many debris as possible!
missions.gridmapv2.survival.title: A Run For Life
missions.gridmapv2.survival.startScreen:
A bunch of obstacles will come your way, some are to be avoided, but others are to be jumped over, bumped into or crashed through to earn extra points! The good ones will be marked with green arrows, so you know where to aim for!

You can also try to keep your vehicle at the top of the screen to get even more points.

Now be careful, if your vehicle falls out of the screen, you won't get much time to get back in before exploding!

If you come across blue circles, these are coins! Drive over them to unlock a repair buff.

Good luck!
missions.gridmapv2.survival.description: Bring your own vehicle in this never-ending scenario. The question isn't whether your vehicle will be wrecked, but when. How long can you last for? In this scenario you'll have to keep avoiding the never-ending flow of obstacles
missions.gridmapv2.survival.wood: Perhaps your vehicle isn't suited for this kind of challenge. Maybe try to take a heavier vehicle with 4 wheel drive.
missions.gridmapv2.survival.bronze: This medal is already a bit difficult to reach. Now try taking even more bonuses!
missions.gridmapv2.survival.silver: Almost there! Now you just need to practice more
missions.gridmapv2.survival.gold: Perfect! Well, your vehicle is still good for the junkyard
missions.crashTest.general.rules:
Your goals is to earn as many points as possible.

To earn points:

  • Follow the instructions during the mission
  • Finish each step as quickly as possible
  • Respect the target speed as much as possible
missions.drift.general.wrongWayFail: It is not authorized to go back up the drift course.
missions.drift.general.driftTips: In order to initiate a drift, while steering left or right, either pull the handbrake for a split second or with a RWD, accelerate. Once the slide is initiated, smoothly use the steering and the gas pedal in order to control the car's angle.
missions.drift.general.outOfTime: You have run out of time, you need to reach the destination in order to have a chance to qualify.
missions.drift.general.title: Minimalistic Gymkhana
missions.drift.general.startScreenBeginn:
Your goal is to earn as many points as possible.

To get points:

  • Drift with a big angle
  • Drift close to the walls
  • Chain together drifts to increase combo
  • Don't crash!
missions.drift.general.driftConfirm: The points earned during a drift will be applied once you have completed the slide without collision.
missions.drift.general.startScreenTarget: You must finish the course in order to qualify.

This is Gymkhana mode. Which means there's no defined route to follow. Use the available bounds to score as many points as you can, in any direction that you choose.
There are stunt zones you can use to obtain extra score too!
missions.drift.general.noMedal: Drifting is difficult. If you keep practicing you will surely make it to the podium. Make sure to take advantage of all options to get more points.
missions.drift.general.bronze: That's somewhere to start! You managed to get those tires screeching!
missions.drift.general.silver: That was a great drifting session, you really know how to handle the car. Some more practice and you'll get the gold!
missions.drift.general.gold: Very nice run there! To reach the gold medal, you pretty much need to do a flawless session. You managed to do that, so well done! That was some impressive handling.
missions.drift.general.platinium: Perfect run, nothing to add. This course has no more secrets for you.

missions.crawl.general.introTipsPointsAn:
Your goal is to reach the end of the course and to get the least penalty points. You start with 0 penalty points, and gain points for the following infractions:
  • Using reverse: +1 point
  • Touching a prop: +5 points
  • Rollover or damaging the vehicle: +5 points
  • Using a recovery checkpoint: +10 points
  • Leaving the area: +10 points

If you leave the area for 5 seconds, you will fail the challenge.
Reaching a [color=#ffff00][b]yellow checkpoint[/b][/color] will create a new recovery position and subtract 10 penalty points. Use [action=reset_physics] or the Menu to recover to your latest recovery position. You can restart the challenge by resetting again after recovery, or using the Menu.

missions.utah.cannon003.description: Clear the roof of the annoying pigeons.
missions.utah.cannon003.intro: Those darn birds are on my roof again! Time to take them down once and for all! There's 4 of them, but I have only 3 cannons..
missions.italy.drift007.title: Village Drift
missions.italy.drift007.description: One of the most difficult drift route, (not the most legal one either). It will require you to have perfect control over your vehicle so you don't hit the curbs.

missions.italy.crawl001.description: A nice crawl on the beach in perfect weather. Make sure to pack a snorkel.

Welcome!

scenarios.utah.guineapig.cargoFellOff.fa: The Covet fell off the trailer
scenarios.utah.crawl.easy.title: Crawl - Dried-Up Riverbed
scenarios.utah.crawl.easy.description: In this crawling track, you'll drive up a dried-up river bed, around the bend and back again!
scenarios.utah.crawl.medium.title: Crawl - Around the Bend
scenarios.utah.crawl.medium.description: This is the first of three crawling tracks. Up a steep rise, then around a cliff bend. Watch for loose rocks!
scenarios.utah.crawl.hard.title: Crawl - Leap of Faith
scenarios.utah.crawl.hard.description: A really challenging crawling track. Down and up the cliffs, finishing with a courageous leap onto a rock pillar!
scenarios.utah.fg-delivery.title: Supply Delivery
scenarios.utah.fg-delivery.description: Your job is to deliver a crate full of supplies to the local ranger station. To get the full score, prove that you can deliver the crate using all three of the available paths to the station!
scenarios.utah.fg-delivery.intro:
Hey, good you're here.

This crate contains supplies for the Ranger Station down the cliffs. There are three different routes you can take.

The Asphalt Road route is directly to the left when leaving the parking area, and the Upper and Lower Dirt Road routes are to the right.

This may go without saying, but make sure that the crate does not fall off and stays undamaged!

Good luck.
scenarios.utah.fg-delivery.couple: Reverse into the trailer to couple.
scenarios.utah.fg-delivery.asphalt: You take the Asphalt Road route.
scenarios.utah.fg-delivery.upper: You take the Upper Dirt Road route.
scenarios.utah.fg-delivery.lower: You take the Lower Dirt Road route.
scenarios.utah.fg-delivery.proceed: Great! Now proceed to deliver the crate. There are multiple paths you can take!
scenarios.utah.fg-delivery.lost: Looks like the crate fell off.
scenarios.utah.fg-delivery.complete: Your delivery is complete. Well done!
scenarios.utah.fg-delivery.doneOne: Great! Thanks for the supplies. You look like a pretty good driver. Do you think you can deliver the next package using another road?
scenarios.utah.fg-delivery.doneTwo: I knew you could do it again. But... there is still another road to take.
scenarios.utah.fg-delivery.doneThree: Pretty impressive! You are truly a master delivery driver. I'll be sure to call for you next time I need something delivered in this tricky terrain.
scenarios.utah.fg-demo.title: Flowgraph Demo Jump
scenarios.utah.fg-demo.description: This is a simple demo scenario which uses the Flowgraph system instead of the scenario system. Your objective is to jump through the pillars of a bridge without hitting anything.
scenarios.utah.fg-demo.damaged: How did you manage to break your vehicle on the way to the bridge?!
scenarios.utah.fg-demo.almost: I told you not to hit anything on your way down... But you made the jump at least.
scenarios.utah.cannon002.title: Delivery Destruction
scenarios.utah.cannon002.description: Deal as much damage as possible to this delivery of luxurious cars before they can reach the tunnel with the help of some cannons.
scenarios.utah.cannon002.intro:
Deal as much damage as possible to the truck and it's cargo. Stop it before it gets to the tunnel for a perfect score.

You will be using precariously placed cannons to take it down, so think about your aim carefully to get the best chance of annihilating your target.
scenarios.utah.cannon001.title: Gang interception
scenarios.utah.cannon001.description: Take out this gang before they can reach the bridge.
scenarios.utah.cannon001.intro: 3 cars, 4 cannons. There's not much margin for error there. But you have to take them all out before they are out of reach beyond the bridge.
scenarios.west_coast_usa.busdriver_stunt: Action Chase
Complete the course with enough speed to land a jump onto the target vehicle and crush it. Bonus points if you can bump the vehicle right after the hairpin!
With a bit of CGI we might have some usable footage here...
Pancaked it! That's the sort of stunt work we need!
What's wrong, can't find the gas pedal?
I thought the vehicle was going to get more damaged than that... we'll have to try this one again.
What's this? You're supposed to crush the vehicle, not tap it!
Missed it entirely! You know we're paying the film crew by the hour, right?
This won't work, you didn't land on top of the vehicle...
Finale: Ballistic Bus

Now that we've wrapped up filming, we've also convinced the city of Belasco to host our movie's promotional world record attempt.[br][br] All you have to do is fire the rockets and hit the ramp dead center. I hope you packed a parachute!
That was spectacular! Don't worry about the mess, there's no such thing as bad publicity. Into the record books you go!
Ouch, not quite the flight I was hoping for...
Journey to the Set Location
You're hired! We're in a real hurry though, so make sure you keep up with the film crew vehicle so that we can arrive at the motorsports park on schedule.
Why did I bother hiring a stunt driver if you can't even keep up with the film crew?
Just in time - we need to get this set unpacked and start filming.
I'm starting to think you're just plain bad luck...
Carnage Course
Complete the course within the time limit. You might need to get creative: the props department has left some... er, hazards lying around.
More speed! This is an action movie, not a drama!
That's what I want to see, skilled driving and plenty of destruction!
Stunt 2: Jump

Now that you're all warmed up, we're throwing you in the deep end. We need an epic jump for the second chase sequence, and if you want your spine to survive the landing I'd suggest aiming for the vehicle shells. [br][br] Also, I told the crew to rig the bus with some nitrous , so make sure that's turned on before you start (use [action=toggleNitrousOxide]).
If you're going to do that much damage to the bus, why did we bother putting the cars there to cushion your landing?
What's taking so long? Don't you know you've got a tank of nitrous oxide in the back?
Prelude: A Normal Day at Work
Safely transport your passengers down the mountain
So you're the hero from the headlines? I could use a skilled driver like you for some stunts in my upcoming film production. Let me know if you're interested.
The bomb exploded
You failed to drive the bus to a safe location
You crashed
scenarios.west_coast_usa.wcaAutobelloSho: A technical time trial around Belasco City showcasing the Autobello Piccolina
scenarios.west_coast_usa.mountain_race.d: Compete for victory on the twisty mountain roads of West Coast USA
missions.west_coast_usa.timeTrial.Alleyw: Take the difficult route through the center to the top of the course.

missions.west_coast_usa.drift001.title: Diner Drift
missions.west_coast_usa.drift001.descrip: Your date is waiting for you at the nearest restaurant. I once heard the fastest way to drive from A to B is to be drifting all the way there. Get there fast, and mostly in style.
missions.west_coast_usa.drift004.title: Dockyard Drift
missions.west_coast_usa.drift004.descrip: Wide roads in a secluded part of town.. By the look of it, we aren't the first and won't be the last to take advantage of it. It looks like the perfect street drifting practice area.
missions.west_coast_usa.drift005.title: Parking Lot By Night
missions.west_coast_usa.drift005.descrip: Drift the parking lot. You might wake up the whole neighborhood but well, who cares? 60 seconds, in and out.
missions.west_coast_usa.drift006.title: Circuit Drift
missions.west_coast_usa.drift006.descrip: Refine your drifting skills by following a course without crashing or spinning out.
missions.west_coast_usa.drift006.goldTex: Well done! Now that you have managed to get the third star, I defy you to get the bonus star for this stage. Basically : Hold your drift throughout the entire lap.
missions.west_coast_usa.drift006.platini: Very complicated star to reach, and yet you got it. Very impressive!
missions.west_coast_usa.drift007.title: Gymkhana Bootcamp
missions.west_coast_usa.drift007.descrip: Get a feel for drifting in this beginner-friendly challenge.
missions.west_coast_usa.drift008.title: Drift Basics
missions.west_coast_usa.drift008.descrip: One hand on the wheel while the other one is on the handbrake. Welcome to your first precision drifting session.
scenarios.west_coast_usa.west_coast_chas:
A semi truck is causing havoc on the highway.

We must stop it at all costs! It won't be easy, but you don't have to worry about damaging your vehicle.
The semi truck got too far away, you lost it..
Your vehicle is nearly totaled, it cannot continue the chase..
Great job! That was an intense chase, but the truck was no match for your driving skills!
missions.west_coast_usa.fallOff.title: A Leap Of Destruction
missions.west_coast_usa.fallOff.descript: I hope you don't have vertigo. If you do... just don't look down in this challenge alright? The goal there is straight forward : Ram as many cars off the building as possible within 60 seconds
missions.west_coast_usa.fallOff.startScr:
The goal here is simple : Push as many cars off the building as possible within sixty seconds!

Use the spinners to your own risks!

You can get the following medals by pushing cars off the roof:
  • Gold: 12 cars
  • Silver: 9 cars
  • Bronze: 6 cars


Good Luck!
missions.west_coast_usa.fallOff.noMedal: You didn't push enough cars off the edge to be on the podium.
missions.west_coast_usa.fallOff.bronze: You did push some cars off the building, but you're going to need more to reach gold!
missions.west_coast_usa.fallOff.fail: You have to remain on the building to win!
missions.west_coast_usa.cannon001.title: A Flock Of Pigeons
missions.west_coast_usa.cannon001.descri: Six pigeons, four cannons. Take them all out like bowling pins to win!
missions.west_coast_usa.cannon001.intro: In this challenge you have to take out every single one of those pigeons from afar to win. One advice : don't hesitate to change the camera view to get a better angle for your shot.
Jump from the dam and aim for the targets.

Zip down the dam and fly towards the targets! You have three attempts. Your points will be added up at the end of your turns.

The targets have various point values, based on their difficulty. Also, you can get up to a 3x multiplier for target center accuracy.
You need to go forward, not backward.
You need to take the jump, not the road.
scenarios.automation_test_track.damclimb: Can your vehicle climb up the 45° dam spillway?
scenarios.automation_test_track.drift001: Drift around this tricky handling circuit.

Where is the best place to practice drifting? A handling track of course! The relatively large banks would make you think that this run is going to be easy, but if you try to stay on track as much as possible, you will see that some turns are rather tricky. Have fun!
scenarios.utah.prototype.arrival.title: Arriving in Utah
scenarios.utah.prototype.arrival.descrip: Hi Freshman, finally you've arrived here in [color=#008000][b]Utah[/b][/color]. [color=#FFA500][b]Visit me[/b][/color] at [color=#008000][b]AJ Auto Reparation[/b][/color] let's see what you're made of or if you're just a tiny sissy who wrecks it's vehicle within the first steps.
scenarios.utah.prototype.arrival.portrai: Hi Freshman, finally you've arrived here in [color=#008000][b]Utah[/b][/color]. [color=#FFA500][b]Visit me[/b][/color] at [color=#008000][b]AJ Auto Reparation[/b][/color] let's see what you're made of or if you're just a tiny sissy who wrecks it's vehicle within the first steps.
scenarios.utah.prototype.arrival.pass.ms: Not bad for a freshman. I could certainly use your help around here. But if you feel like learning more about driving, visit [color=#4169E1][b]my brother[/b][/color] at [color=#008000][b]ETK Racing Experience Center[/b][/color].
scenarios.utah.prototype.arrival.timeLim: Is it really that hard? Maybe you should play some arcade racing games instead?
scenarios.utah.prototype.arrival.positio: Is it really that hard? Maybe you should play some arcade racing games instead?
scenarios.italy.pizzaDelivery1.title: Pizza Delivery
scenarios.italy.pizzaDelivery1.descripti: Deliver the pizzas during your route across town.
scenarios.italy.pizzaDelivery1.portraitT: Ei, ragazzo! The boss wants you to drop off some pizzas. Get those deliveries out there quickly, and be sure to actually stop for the customer this time! Oh, and some kinda protest is going on in the city, so you'll have to improvise. I trust you remember all the old shortcuts...
scenarios.italy.pizzaDelivery1.fail_stop: You didn't stop for the customer!
scenarios.italy.pizzaDelivery1.success_f: Wow... you must be the fastest pizza delivery driver in the city!
Hey, go offer the protestanti some pizza. Maybe then they'll shut up!
scenarios.italy.pizzaDelivery1.success_s: You sure are cutting it close on those deliveries!
You are the slowest delivery driver that I've ever met!
scenarios.italy.tastiColaDelivery1.title: TastiCola Delivery
scenarios.italy.tastiColaDelivery1.descr: Deliver a trailer of TastiCola to the Citta Vecchia shops.
scenarios.italy.electricHypermilling.des: Your E-SBR batteries are low. Can you make it to the nearest charge point, in Castelletto?
scenarios.italy.crestRoadAutobello.title: Field Run
scenarios.italy.crestRoadAutobello.descr: Can you be fast enough to keep up with the other Baja Piccolina through bumpy terrain?
You were too far from the other vehicle...
scenarios.italy.crestRoadAutobello.win.o: Well done! You were so fast you even managed to overtake the vehicle that you were only supposed to follow.
scenarios.italy.crestRoadAutobello.far.m: Keep up with the other vehicle!
scenarios.italy.fg-gravity.title: Gravity Fuel
scenarios.italy.fg-gravity.rollDown: Follow the road down the hill and fill up at the petrol station.
scenarios.italy.fg-gravity.description: You're out of fuel. Coast down the hill in the racecar and grab fuel then return it to the pickup so that we can deliver the vehicle!
scenarios.italy.fg-gravity.intro:
Oh no! Our lousy pickup truck has just run out of fuel!

Unfortunately, the racecar's fuel tank is also empty! Fortunately it's early morning and there is no traffic on the roads. Coast down the hill in the racecar to the service station at the bottom. Fill it up and drive it back here so that we can get this thing delivered on time.

Remember, there was a sharp turn at the bottom of the hill, don't try to take the last corner too fast!

Whatever you do, don't put a dent on the vehicle, or it will come out of your pay!
scenarios.italy.fg-gravity.destroyed: The vehicle has been destroyed, you're fired!
scenarios.italy.fg-gravity.stoppedmoving: You stopped moving. I guess you didn't make it!
scenarios.italy.fg-gravity.getback: We've got enough! Lets take the fuel back to the truck!
scenarios.italy.fg-gravity.park: Park the vehicle back on the trailer.
scenarios.italy.fg-gravity.pushVehicleTe: Would you like to retry, or just push the vehicle to the fuel station?
scenarios.italy.fg-gravity.shiftDesc: Which shiftmode do you want to use to drive back?
scenarios.italy.fg-gravity.tooManyResets: You reset the vehicle too many times, try the scenario again from the start!
scenarios.italy.fg-gravity.destroyedTrai: You were supposed to park the vehicle ON the trailer, not INSIDE the trailer! The trailer is broken so now we can't deliver the vehicle, you're fired!
scenarios.italy.fg-gravity.success: You've done it, lets get this vehicle delivered!
scenarios.italy.supercarTransport.title: Supercar Transport
scenarios.italy.supercarTransport.descri:
Somebody called the roadside assistance! Their Civetta Bolide needs a transport to the garage.

Reach the location, and speak with the client. This is a quite pricy supercar, please be careful.
scenarios.italy.supercarTransport.phase1: Do you want to manually load the vehicle on the truck's bed?
scenarios.italy.supercarTransport.phase2:
The client asked if it is possible to deliver the supercar to his friend's garage in the town at the top of the mountain. What do you want to do?

[img]../../../../../levels/italy/scenarios/supercarTransport/supercarTransport_routes.jpg[/img]
scenarios.italy.supercarTransport.gold.t: The vehicle is in perfect condition, and you made the client happy. Well done!
scenarios.italy.supercarTransport.silver: The vehicle was delivered in optimal conditions, good job.
scenarios.italy.supercarTransport.bronze: The vehicle was delivered, but it received some damage during the transport..
scenarios.italy.supercarTransport.fail.t: That is going to be hard to explain to the client..

missions.garage.intro:
In this scenario, you will be delivering various vehicles from one place to another.
There is no time limit, but you will only get one attempt per vehicle!
You can damage the vehicle as much as you want, as long as it can still get to the destination.
Before each job, you will get some info about the location, the traffic situation and other stuff.
There will be navigation aids, but you can choose your own route.
Happy delivering!

missions.gridmap_v2.delivery.obstaclecou: A dangerous obstacle course featuring large spinners.

Navigate your way through a challenging obstacle course made up of three perilous rooms, featuring massive spinning hazards designed to thwart your delivery.

Your mission is to deliver an empty barrel to the end zone as quickly as possible. Speed and precision are key.

The final room demands full throttle and precise gear shifting to build enough speed to get the barrel across the finish line.

Important: Only the barrel needs to reach the end zone, not your truck.

Tip: Adjust your drivetrain settings before starting to maximize your chances of success.

If the mission doesn't complete when you reach the end, this means that the barrel has not made it to the end zone somehow. Restart and try again!

Have Fun!
