You've loaded some trashed oil barrels onto your trailer. Now, carefully transport them to the gas station. Follow the dirt road until it ends, then turn left onto the main road.
missions.delivery.industrial.garbagePige: Bring your trailer full of furniture to the garbage station.
Arriving in the area with your trailer full of furniture, find your way on the industrial grounds to the garbage station. There are multiple paths that you can take.
That's a lot of trash! We'll take care of it.
Looks like a few pieces fell off...
Wasn't there a lot more trash when you got into the area?
You know, you're supposed to bring your trash here, not scatter it over the countryside!
missions.delivery.industrial.garbageLegr: Bring your trailer full of trash to the garbage station.
Arriving in the area in your trusty LeGran, make your way to the garbage station to get rid of all the old junk. There are multiple routes that you can take.
That's a lot of trash! We'll take care of it.
Looks like a few pieces fell off...
Wasn't there a lot more trash when you got into the area?
You know, you're supposed to bring your trash here, not scatter it over the countryside!
missions.delivery.italy.mattresses.title: Mattress Cleaning
missions.delivery.italy.mattresses.descr: The castle's mattresses need to be brought to the cleaning place.
missions.delivery.italy.mattresses.intro: These old mattresses need to be deep-cleaned. There's a special cleaning place we usually bring them to, just outside of town. Oh, you can take all of them at once, right?
missions.delivery.italy.mattresses.goldM: I'll get right to work, these mattresses will be cleaned in no time!
missions.delivery.italy.mattresses.silve: Ah, the mattresses I expected. I'll clean them for you now.
missions.delivery.italy.mattresses.bronz: That's quite a big vehicle you've used to transport so few mattresses.
missions.delivery.italy.mattresses.failM: Where did you leave all those mattresses?
This Bastion cannot be repaired here. Bring it to a different shop.
We don't have the right tools here to repair the bastion, and I guess it's easier to move the vehicle than to bring new tools here. The customer wants it fixed as soon as possible. So, move!
You're right on time! We'll get right to work.
A bit late, but we'll start working now.
missions.delivery.italy.tastiCola.title: TastiCola Restock
missions.delivery.italy.tastiCola.descri: The people of Città Vecchia need TastiCola.
missions.delivery.italy.tastiCola.introM: The shops of Città Vecchia need to be restocked with this tasty, tasty TastiCola. It's a long drive and there's a bit of traffic, so move carefully.
missions.delivery.italy.tastiCola.goldMe: Right on time! There are dozens of people waiting for some refreshments!
missions.delivery.italy.tastiCola.silver: A bit late, are you not? There are people running through the doors looking for TastiCola here!
missions.delivery.jungle_rock_island.pip: Deliver a set of pipes to the Industrial Area.

We've got this big load of pipes that is needed at the industrial site for construction. It is needed urgently, but the path is treacherous and there's some traffic. Are you up to the task?
Make use of the differentials to get up steep slopes.
Great! You're right on time, we will get this unloaded quickly.
What's taken you so long? I don't want to pay my workers for waiting!
missions.delivery.jungle_rock_island.loo: Deliver some unsecured planks of wood to the old resort.

Someone forgot to tie down the wooden planks, but there's no time to do that now. Can you transport them to the resort anyway?
Make use of the differentials to get up steep slopes and use the compression brake to keep a controlled speed on steep declines.
Thanks for the delivery! Exactly what we needed.
Thanks for the delivery. Looks like you lost a bundle or two though...
So few...? I thought we were supposed to get seven of them?
missions.delivery.small_island.upRocks.d: Transport the equipment for the research team to the top of the hill.
missions.delivery.small_island.upRocks.i:
The Rocks Research Team up on the hill needs their "mining equipment" for some "delicate research". Be very careful with it, that thing weighs more than five tons and due to its massive size, it is very top-heavy.
Be sure to make use of the differentials to get up the hills.
missions.delivery.small_island.upRocks.g: Great! This will allow us to carefully extract rock samples from the local area.
missions.delivery.small_island.downRocks: Transport the research team's rocky findings to the station.

We managed to get a few tonnes of interesting samples out of the local area. Can you haul them down to the other station so they can inspect them with their special tools?
Make use of the differentials to get up steep slopes and use the compression brake to keep a controlled speed on steep declines. There are multiple routes that you can chose from to arrive at the destination.
Thanks! We will get to work right now.
missions.delivery.italy.scintilla.title: Scintilla Delivery
missions.delivery.italy.scintilla.descri: Deliver three Civetta Scintillas on a flatbed truck.
missions.delivery.italy.scintilla.introM: A group of super-rich investors are doing a private race on their island. You're in charge of delivering three special Civetta Scintillas that have just been flown in by plane to the port so they can be shipped over. Make sure you don't drop or damage any of them!
missions.delivery.italy.scintilla.goldMe: You did it! If everything is in pristine condition, you might get a tip.
missions.delivery.italy.scintilla.silver: Looks like you dropped one of them! Oh well. I guess they have enough money to buy another one.
missions.delivery.italy.scintilla.bronze: How are we supposed to do a race with only one car?
missions.delivery.italy.scintilla.failMe: No Cars? Your manager will hear about this
missions.delivery.gmv2.pit.title: Soccer Pit 1
missions.delivery.gmv2.pit.description: Maneuver eight soccer balls into the pit.
missions.delivery.gmv2.pit.introMessage: Deliver all eight soccer balls into the pit! Be careful though, they can easily roll away.
missions.delivery.gmv2.pit.goldMessage: All eight! It looks like you really know how to handle this.
missions.delivery.gmv2.pit.silverMessage: Almost! You can also hit the balls once and let them roll into the pit.
missions.delivery.gmv2.pit.bronzeMessage: Make sure not to kick the balls so far away you that need to spend time to chase them down.
missions.delivery.gmv2.pit.failMessage: You can do it! Give it a few more tries and you will likely succeed.
missions.delivery.gmv2.longpit.title: Soccer Pit 2
missions.delivery.gmv2.longpit.descripti: Kick three soccer balls from a distance into the pit.
missions.delivery.gmv2.longpit.introMess: Deliver all three balls into the pit. A good method for this is to give them a firm, precise push and then let them roll the distance.
missions.delivery.gmv2.longpit.goldMessa: All three! You're very precise with this.
missions.delivery.gmv2.longpit.silverMes: Make sure you hit the balls precisely to get them into the pit.
missions.delivery.gmv2.longpit.bronzeMes: Try altering the camera angle to make sure you're on the correct path to hit the ball correctly.
missions.delivery.gmv2.longpit.failMessa: Try working on your aim a bit.
missions.delivery.gmv2.crazypit.title: Crazy Soccer Pit
missions.delivery.gmv2.crazypit.descript: Maneuver as many soccer balls as you can into the pit within one minute!
missions.delivery.gmv2.crazypit.introMes: Deliver as many soccer balls as you can into the pit. You have one minute, so good luck!
missions.delivery.driver_training.delive: Learn how to tow a trailer to a destination.

To work on the track for a future challenge, we need some tools and props. We've loaded what we can into a crate and placed it all onto a trailer. Park the truck so its tow hitch is close to the hitch on the trailer, then get out and activate the trigger on the tow hitch to connect them.

Tow the trailer to the drop-off area, then get out and activate the hitch trigger again to unhitch it. Once the trailer is dropped off, return the truck to the marked parking spot.
Great job! Everything is here, so lets get building.
I guess a few cones fell off, but we can get those. You got the trailer here at least.
I don't know how you managed to lose all the cones on the short way here, but at least we have the tools from the crate.
missions.delivery.west_coast_usa.sportsG: Deliver new sports equipment to the tennis courts near the city.

The sports club near the city has ordered new equipment. Start the truck, then park it so the tow hitch is close to the trailer hitch. Get out and activate the tow hitch trigger to connect the trailer.

Once the trailer is hitched, bring the trailer and sports equipment into the tennis court drop-off area to finish the delivery.
Thanks! A few things are missing though...?
Thanks for the delivery! We've been waiting some time though...
Great! Thanks for the delivery! Right on time as well!
missions.delivery.west_coast_usa.furnitu: Deliver a set of Furniture to the residential area.
Some folks over the other side of the highway ordered some new couches. Deliver them!
That's all? Where's all the rest?
It looks like there's something missing...?
Thanks for the delivery! Now we can complete our living room setup!
missions.delivery.west_coast_usa.tastiCo: Deliver some fresh beverages to a dealership.
Rich's Motor Company ordered fresh beverages to lure in new customers. After a quick stop, it's time to drive the final stretch.
Thanks for the delivery. We need this stuff.
Thanks! Just in time as well.
Great! Even earlier than we expected. This gives us more time to prepare.
missions.delivery.west_coast_usa.fuel.de: Refuel the Gas Station near the racetrack.
missions.delivery.west_coast_usa.fuel.in: Haul this big tanker full of gas to the gas station, so they can sell it. Be careful, it's very heavy and the route is longer than it may look.
missions.delivery.west_coast_usa.fuel.st: Right on time! Thanks a lot.
How'd you get here so fast? Thanks a lot!
missions.delivery.west_coast_usa.tower.d: Deliver supplies to the radio tower.
missions.delivery.west_coast_usa.tower.i:
You need to bring this crate full of snacks to the radio tower. There's also a trailer full of equipment you need to get out of the docks area.

Start the truck, then park it so the tow hitch is close to the trailer hitch. Get out and activate the tow hitch trigger to connect the trailer. Once the trailer is hitched, bring the trailer and supplies into the radio tower drop-off area to finish the delivery. Careful when going up the hill, there are some steep edges.
missions.delivery.west_coast_usa.tower.s: Thanks for delivering all those supplies in such good time!
missions.delivery.west_coast_usa.movingA: Help a neighbour by moving some boxes.
A neighbour has asked you to help them move some big boxes to another house. It's not a long drive, but it will be a lot easier for them than carrying it all by hand!
Picking up the stuff you dropped will take us longer than getting it all here manually...
You lost something along the way.
Thanks! I knew we could count on neighbours for helping each other out.
missions.delivery.west_coast_usa.tastiCo: The racetrack organizers need a big load of beverages to serve to some famous guests. Get them there safely!
Thanks! Just in time as well.
Great! Even earlier than we expected.
missions.delivery.west_coast_usa.truckIn: Get used to driving a big truck with a big trailer.

So you want to get some experience as a truck driver? Drive this monsterous thing over to the other side of the industrial area. It's a short ride, but it should give you some feeling on how these things handle before you do some real deliveries with it.

Take your time and drive carefully.
Great! Hopefully this practice will help you in the future.
missions.delivery.west_coast_usa.trailer: Practice coupling and driving with a small trailer.

Here you can practice how to couple and drive with a small trailer. The trailer is already loaded with some 200KG weight of cargo. Don't worry though, it's secured to the trailer and won't fall out.

I've set a marker to help you couple the truck to the trailer: First turn right and align with the parking spot, then slowly reverse into the trailer. Press [action=couplersToggle] to activate the couplers. Wait for the vehicle to connect and then you're good to go!

Feel free to drive around and get a feel for driving with the trailer. When you're done, head over the bridge and drive to the other parking spot. Take all the time you need!
Great! Practicing this will surely help you with future deliveries.
missions.delivery.west_coast_usa.beginne: Help APM evaluate this standard fleet pickup truck on our test course. We need data on its basic handling characteristics before introducing cargo variables.

Welcome to your first APM Commercial Division assessment. Today we're gathering baseline data on our standard fleet pickup truck's handling characteristics.

Your objective is to navigate through the marked course, following the chalk outlines and passing through all flag gates. Maintain a steady pace - we need accurate performance data, so drive efficiently but carefully. There's a target time to complete the course, but focus on clean driving rather than racing.

APM's systems will be recording vehicle dynamics throughout your run. This data helps us establish baseline performance metrics for our fleet vehicles. Complete the course and come to a full stop within the marked circle at the end. Remember, vehicle damage will compromise our test data, so drive with precision.
Test complete! Your driving has provided APM with excellent baseline data on this vehicle's performance characteristics.
Good performance metrics! Your consistent driving has provided APM with reliable data on this vehicle's everyday capabilities. This efficient handling profile will be valuable for our assessment.

Exceptional performance metrics! Your efficient driving has provided APM with valuable data on this vehicle's optimal handling capabilities. Your precision and speed have been noted in our driver assessment database.
Now we're adding weight to the same vehicle. Navigate the test course with this lumber load so APM can analyze how added bed weight affects vehicle performance.

Now that we've established baseline performance data, we're adding a variable: cargo weight. Today you'll navigate the same test course, but with a load of lumber in the truck bed.

Your objective remains the same - follow the marked chalk lines and pass through all flag gates at a steady pace. Note how the added weight affects acceleration, braking distance, and cornering stability.

APM's sensors will be measuring how the vehicle handles with this cargo load. Complete the course and stop within the marked circle at the end. Pay close attention to how differently the vehicle responds compared to your unloaded test. This comparative data is crucial for our fleet performance analysis.
Excellent work! The performance differences between loaded and unloaded configurations have been successfully recorded in APM's database.
Solid handling with a loaded vehicle! You've demonstrated effective management of cargo weight while maintaining good pace. These practical performance metrics will enhance our comparative analysis.

Remarkable efficiency with a loaded vehicle! Your ability to maintain speed while safely managing cargo weight demonstrates exactly the kind of handling data APM values most. This performance benchmark will be highlighted in our reports.
Take this lumber load to the construction site downtown. APM is collecting real-world delivery data on vehicle performance in urban conditions.

It's time to apply what you've learned in a real-world scenario. Today you'll be delivering this lumber load to the construction site downtown.

Your task is to transport the cargo safely and efficiently through actual traffic conditions. Drive at appropriate speeds and maintain awareness of other vehicles. APM will be gathering data on how our test vehicle performs in authentic delivery scenarios.

Navigate to the marked construction site on your GPS and park carefully in the designated delivery zone. Remember that vehicle preservation is essential - any damage compromises both the delivery and our test data. This final assessment completes your evaluation of our standard fleet pickup.
Delivery complete and data collected! Your real-world test has provided APM with valuable insights on how our vehicles perform in actual delivery conditions.
Delivery completed efficiently! Your balanced approach to speed and cargo protection provides APM with valuable real-world performance data. These metrics represent practical everyday usage patterns.

Delivery completed with exceptional efficiency! Your combination of speed and cargo protection showcases the optimal performance envelope of this vehicle. APM's clients will be particularly interested in these impressive metrics.
missions.delivery.west_coast_usa.interme: Help APM evaluate this new Sport Wagon on our standard test course. We need baseline data on its handling dynamics before adding cargo variables.

Welcome to your evaluation of APM's Sport Wagon. This versatile vehicle is being considered for an urban delivery fleet, and we need comprehensive performance data.

Today's assessment focuses on baseline handling characteristics. Navigate through the marked test course following the chalk outlines and passing through all flag gates. Maintain a consistent pace to help our systems record accurate data on acceleration, braking, and cornering behavior.

Pay special attention to the Sport Wagon's unique handling profile. Its lower center of gravity and different weight distribution will provide an interesting contrast to our standard delivery vehicles. Complete the course and come to a full stop in the marked circle.
Test complete! Your driving has provided valuable baseline metrics for our Sport Wagon evaluation program.
Good Sport Wagon handling! Your driving demonstrates the vehicle's reliable performance characteristics under controlled conditions. This data provides APM with useful everyday metrics.

Superior handling demonstration! Your ability to maximize the Sport Wagon's performance while maintaining control provides APM with excellent benchmark data. Your driving efficiency has been recorded in our performance database.
Now we're testing the Sport Wagon's limits with a full payload. Navigate carefully with the roof-mounted couch and trailer cargo - we're measuring stability under maximum load conditions.

Now we're testing the Sport Wagon at maximum capacity. You'll navigate the same course, but with a couch secured to the roof rack and a trailer carrying heavy electronic equipment.

Your objective remains unchanged - follow the marked path through all flag gates - but expect dramatically different vehicle dynamics. The elevated center of gravity and additional trailer weight will significantly alter handling, braking, and acceleration.

This is an important test of the vehicle's versatility in challenging conditions. Proceed carefully and note how the vehicle responds compared to your unloaded test. Complete the course and stop within the marked circle for data analysis.
Excellent handling under challenging conditions! The comparative data between loaded and unloaded configurations will be invaluable for our assessment.
Well-managed challenging load! You've effectively balanced speed and control with this complex configuration. These performance metrics will strengthen our vehicle capability assessment.

Impressive mastery of challenging conditions! Maintaining such efficiency with this complex load configuration showcases exceptional vehicle control. APM will highlight these optimal performance metrics in our assessment reports.
Transport this furniture and electronics shipment to Horizon Estate. APM is collecting real-world data on how the Sport Wagon performs in residential delivery scenarios.

It's time to evaluate the Sport Wagon in a real-world delivery scenario. Today you'll be transporting this furniture and electronics shipment to a residence in Horizon Estate.

Navigate through actual traffic conditions while managing your unusual load configuration. The combination of roof cargo and trailer presents unique challenges in residential environments with their narrower roads and tighter turns.

Follow your GPS to the delivery address and park carefully in the designated spot. Remember, we're assessing not just successful delivery, but how efficiently and safely the vehicle performs under these demanding conditions. Drive with precision to ensure our test data remains uncompromised.
Delivery successfully completed! Your performance has provided APM with excellent real-world data on the Sport Wagon's capabilities as a versatile delivery vehicle.
Delivery handled competently! Your navigation through real-world conditions with this challenging load configuration provides APM with practical performance insights for our assessment program.

Delivery executed with remarkable precision and speed! Your ability to efficiently navigate real-world conditions with this challenging configuration demonstrates the kind of elite handling data APM values most highly.
missions.delivery.west_coast_usa.advance: Evaluate this commercial delivery truck on our test course. APM is establishing performance benchmarks for our larger fleet vehicles.

Welcome to your evaluation of the Gavril TC83 cabover truck. This commercial vehicle has been loaned to APM by Gavril to gather performance metrics.

Today you'll be testing the truck without a trailer attached. Your task is to navigate through our test course, following the chalk outlines and passing through all flag gates. Note the vehicle's responsive acceleration and strong braking capabilities in its unloaded state.

Pay special attention to the truck's turning radius and handling dynamics. Even without a trailer, this is a substantial vehicle that requires different techniques than our smaller fleet vehicles. Complete the course and bring the truck to a full stop within the marked circle for comprehensive data analysis.
Test complete! Your driving has provided APM with valuable baseline metrics that we'll share with Gavril as part of our fleet assessment program.
Effective commercial vehicle control! Your driving demonstrates the Gavril TC83's reliable performance characteristics. These practical metrics will be valuable for our assessment report.

Outstanding commercial vehicle control! Your ability to maximize the Gavril TC83's performance demonstrates an exceptional understanding of heavy vehicle dynamics. These optimal metrics will be featured in our report to the manufacturer.
Now we're testing with maximum payload and a trailer. Navigate the course while APM monitors how the added weight affects all vehicle systems.

Now we're evaluating the Gavril TC83 with a fully loaded trailer. First, you'll need to connect to the trailer positioned behind the truck.

Back up slowly and straight to align with the fifth wheel connection point. When properly aligned, the truck will automatically couple with the trailer - you'll feel and hear the connection engage.

Once connected, navigate the same course while managing a 48ft dryvan trailer loaded with over 19,000kg of soda. You'll need to make extremely wide turns to accommodate the trailer's length and take corners at significantly reduced speeds. The massive weight will dramatically affect acceleration and require much longer braking distances.

Follow the marked path through all flag gates and come to a complete stop in the designated area. This comparative data will help both APM and Gavril understand the TC83's performance characteristics under maximum load conditions.
Excellent handling of this challenging configuration! The performance differential between solo truck and fully loaded conditions has been successfully documented in our database.
Good management of the fully loaded trailer! You've effectively handled the 19,000kg load while maintaining appropriate control. This data provides valuable practical insights for our assessment.

Remarkable efficiency with fully loaded equipment! Your ability to maintain speed while safely managing a 19,000kg load demonstrates elite handling skills. APM will highlight these exceptional performance benchmarks in our assessment.
Transport this priority cargo to Spearleaf Marine Logistics. APM is analyzing commercial vehicle performance on industrial routes.

It's time to evaluate the Gavril TC83 in a real-world delivery scenario. As in your previous test, first back up slowly to connect with the fifth wheel of the trailer.

Today you'll be transporting this 48ft trailer loaded with 19,000kg of soda to the Spearleaf Marine Logistics container terminal. This route will test the truck's capabilities across highways and industrial access roads.

Remember that this combination requires extensive forward planning - begin braking far earlier than you normally would and approach all turns at appropriate speeds. You'll need to make exceptionally wide turns to navigate corners safely without clipping curbs or other obstacles.

Follow your GPS to the delivery point at the container terminal and position the truck and trailer precisely in the marked unloading zone. Drive carefully to ensure both Gavril and APM receive the most accurate performance data from this real-world test scenario.
Delivery successfully completed! Your skilled handling of the Gavril TC83 under maximum load conditions has provided invaluable data that will help optimize future commercial vehicle designs.

Delivery completed competently! Your balanced approach to managing this heavy configuration in real-world conditions demonstrates the TC83's practical capabilities. This data will help establish reliable performance standards.

Delivery completed with outstanding efficiency! Your combination of speed and precise control with this heavy configuration showcases the maximum potential of the TC83 under real-world conditions. This elite performance data will help establish new benchmarks for commercial vehicle standards.
Recover the overturned camper trailer and tow it to the campsite.

You seem to have taken a wrong turn at some point while driving towards Dunekicker Base Camp. Even worse, your camper trailer somehow got loose and fell over. Start the truck, then park it so the tow hitch is close to the camper hitch. Getting close enough and connecting the hitches should be enough to roll the camper back onto its wheels.

Get out and activate the tow hitch trigger to connect the trailer. Following the roads is going to be far harder than cutting across country, since the roads are very bumpy. Tow the camper trailer to the campsite drop-off area to finish the delivery.
At least you got there safely! Next time, you'll invest into a map and a compass..
Right on time! Because everything worked out fine, you're sure you won't need a map or compass in the future either.
Great! Even earlier than we expected. This gives us more time to prepare.
missions.delivery.johnson_valley.G500Des: Carefully haul the junk across the unforgiving back trails of Johnson Valley!

You've completed your duty of loading your trailer with abandoned junk. Now, make your way back to the highway and deliver it to the settlement. Be patient; you may need to drive very slowly in some sections!
missions.east_coast_usa.freeformDelivery: Take your truck to the forestry, load up with logs and deliver as many as you can to the sawmill.
missions.industrial.freeformDelivery.ssh: Use your truck to bring the three designated trailers to the yard and park them in the shed.
missions.italy.freeformDelivery.quarrylo: Use the loader to move the marble blocks into the unload zone, then park the truck to finish.
missions.italy.freeformDelivery.dduty.de: Three trailers need moving around the port. Take your truck and get it done.
missions.utah.freeformDelivery.wrecks.de: Take a truck and trailer to a nearby area which contains some abandoned vehicles. Use a wheel loader to recover the wrecks and load them onto the trailer. Then bring the wrecks back to the autoshop.
missions.west_coast_usa.freeformDelivery: Get to work, then deliver some goods around WCUSA with a truck and then head back home.
missions.freeformDelivery.common.hint.co: Carefully reverse into a trailer to engage the fifthwheel coupler.
missions.freeformDelivery.common.hint.hi: Get out of the vehicle and activate the tow hitch trigger to connect the trailer.
missions.freeformDelivery.common.goal.pa: Park the truck in its parking spot to finish.
Park the trailer in the drop-off area.
missions.freeformDelivery.common.hint.dr: Bring the required vehicles or cargo into this area to finish the delivery.
missions.freeformDelivery.common.routePr: Use the Radial Menu [action=toggleRadialMenuMulti] > {{radialActions}} > {{delivery}} or the {{map}} [action=toggleBigMap] to navigate to the target location.
Use the Radial Menu [action=toggleRadialMenuMulti] > {{radialActions}} > {{delivery}} or the {{map}} [action=toggleBigMap] to navigate to one of {{count}} target locations.
missions.freeformDelivery.common.allGoal: All goals completed! Finishing in {{seconds}} seconds...
missions.freeformDelivery.common.quickAc: End the current delivery and show summary
missions.east_coast_usa.freeformDelivery: Use the Forestry Loader to load logs onto the truck, then park the loader in its parking spot to continue.
Use the Sawmill Loader to unload any number of logs into the unload log rack and return it to its parking spot (optional).
Drive the truck to the forestry zone and park it in a good spot for loading.
Load the logs onto the truck.
Bring the truck to the sawmill (you can take as many logs as you can manage).
Unload logs into the unload area.
Optional: Park the Sawmill Loader back in its parking spot.
Park the truck in its parking spot to finish.
Deliver logs from the Forestry to the Sawmill.
Unload 1 log into the log rack
Unload 4 logs into the log rack
Unload 8 logs into the log rack
Pick up a customer race car with your rollback van and deliver it to the destination.

You've got an expensive race car to collect with your rollback van. Drive to the loading station, load the race car, then deliver it to the client's house. Be careful with it though, it isn't tied down!
Park the rollback van in the loading area so the race car can be loaded.
Bring the race car to the client's house, then park it in the marked delivery spot.
Drive the rollback van to the loading station.
Bring the race car to the client's house.
Park the race car in the delivery spot.
Park the rollback van in its parking spot to finish.
missions.industrial.freeformDelivery.ssh: Carefully reverse into a trailer to engage the fifthwheel coupler.
Park each trailer fully inside its marked parking spot then decouple the fifthwheel coupler. You will need to reverse into two of the parking spots.
Deliver the Wood Trailer to its parking spot.
Deliver the Container Trailer to its parking spot.
Deliver the TastiCola Trailer to its parking spot.
Park the truck in its parking spot to finish.
Park the trailers in their designated spots.
missions.italy.freeformDelivery.quarrylo: Take the truck and pick up the trailer.
Use the Block Yard loader to unload the blocks from the truck and place them by the others where the green patch is. Gently tip them off of the loader forks and onto the ground.
Use the Quarry Loader to place a block onto the trailer, then bring the trailer to the block yard gantry spot.
Take the trailer to the quarry.
Park the trailer with one marble block under the block yard gantry, use the map navigation to find the exact spot.
Park the truck in its parking spot to finish.
Bring a marble block to the Block Yard.
missions.italy.freeformDelivery.dduty.hi: Carefully reverse into a trailer to engage the fifthwheel coupler.
missions.italy.freeformDelivery.dduty.go: Park the truck in its parking spot to finish.
missions.italy.freeformDelivery.dduty.in: Park the trailers in their designated spots.
missions.utah.freeformDelivery.wrecks.hi: Take the trailer from the autoshop area. Bring it back with the wrecks loaded on it. After you park the trailer, finish the mission by parking the truck in the truck parking spot.
Use the loader to pick up each wreck from underneath and place it onto the trailer.
missions.utah.freeformDelivery.wrecks.go: Drive the truck to the autoshop.
Connect the fifth wheel to the trailer.
Bring the trailer to the loading area.
Optional: Once you are finished, park the loader back in its parking spot.
Park the truck in the truck parking spot beside the gas station to finish.
missions.utah.freeformDelivery.wrecks.in: Bring three wrecks to the Autoshop.
missions.west_coast_usa.freeformDelivery: Get in your vehicle and drive to work at the port on Spearleaf Island.

You have two trailer consignments to deliver to the movie studio and one to bring back here from the steel mill. Connect the pipe trailer to the back of the B-Train trailer and deliver them to the movie studio logistics block.

Consider detaching the rear trailer before attempting to park the B-Train trailer. You will need to disembark from the truck and activate the hitch release lever at the back of the B-Train trailer manually, to unhitch the rear trailer.
Drive to work at the port and park in your spot.
Pick up the steel load from the steel mill.
Park the truck in its parking spot.
Park your car at home to finish.
Drive to work and deliver some cargo.
missions.driver_training.timeTrial.arden: Tackle a tight and technical course in the Ardente Frisson.

How quickly can you get the Ardente Frisson through this technical test course?  Be wary of the low friction sections. You will need to control the vehicle carefully around these slippery surfaces in order to keep the run clean.
missions.east_coast_usa.timeTrial.ardent: A high speed, technical route through the rural areas of East Coast USA.

This high speed loop has some hard braking zones which lead into very tight turns.

Stay sharp and keep looking ahead for warning signs.
missions.jungle_rock_island.delivery.lig: Tackle a long and treacherous offroad route with a trailer and a steep climb up to the lighthouse.

The lighthouse needs vital repair parts to operate this evening to safely guide the next round of tourists to the island. You need to get the crate of parts there from the airport. There was a storm last night which brought trees down over some of the roads, so you will need to take the long route there. Take your time and be very careful on this tricky route through the jungle. Be wary of water crossings, rocks, eroded roads and tight turns. When you arrive at the lighthouse we need you to get the trailer up to the shed level.
missions.arrive.message.keepMoving: Get moving! If you are stuck press reset [action=reset_physics]
missions.arrive.general.aiWarning: Get closer to the other vehicle!
missions.arrive.general.damageFail: Your vehicle has too much damage!
missions.arrive.general.escortFail: You failed to stay close to the other vehicle!
missions.arrive.general.gForceFail: Your driving was not smooth enough!
missions.arrive.general.arriveOnTime: Perfect, you arrived here on time.
missions.arrive.goals.arriveMarkerStop: Park your vehicle at the destination.
missions.arrive.goals.followMarkers: Follow the blue navigation markers to the destination to complete the challenge.
missions.arrive.goals.escortAI: Stay close to the other vehicle.
missions.arrive.stars.noRecoverOnTime: Avoid using vehicle recovery, and arrive within {{time | time}}.
missions.arrive.italy.blancoAuto.title: Blanco Delivery
missions.arrive.italy.blancoAuto.descrip: Take a little package and drop it off to a location that is across the island at our storage shack.
missions.arrive.italy.blancoAuto.startSc:
Take this small package and deliver it to a location that is across the island.

It's sensitive so don't get carried away and start playing bumper cars. We need it there pronto, you got it?

Just show up to the shack and we'll take care of it.
missions.arrive.italy.escursionismo.desc: A treacherous drive along the tops of the Italian mountain ridges!
missions.arrive.italy.escursionismo.star: Head down the narrow dirt path to the paved road and take it across the top of the mountain range to finish on a dirt road on the other side. Be careful, there are a lot of blind corners and fatal cliffsides!
missions.arrive.italy.freewayA.title: Freeway Run 'Route A'
missions.arrive.italy.freewayA.descripti: A fun (possibly highspeed!) run along the freeway from one end to the other!
missions.arrive.italy.freewayA.startScre: Traverse the entire freeway with light traffic. You have three minutes.
missions.arrive.italy.freewayB.title: Freeway Run 'Route B'
missions.arrive.italy.freewayB.descripti: A fun (possibly highspeed!) run along the freeway from one end to the other!
missions.arrive.italy.freewayB.startScre: Traverse the entire freeway with light traffic. You have three minutes.
missions.arrive.italy.villaVIP.title: Villa VIP Delivery
missions.arrive.italy.villaVIP.descripti: Drive a VIP to their Villa!
missions.arrive.italy.villaVIP.startScre: Drive the VIP to their villa, please drive with care and do not speed or you will fail!
missions.arrive.italy.airport001.title: Airport Chauffeur - Castle
missions.arrive.italy.airport001.descrip: Chauffeur your passenger to the castle.
missions.arrive.italy.airport001.startSc: You've picked up a passenger at the airport, they would like a lift to Castelletto!
missions.arrive.italy.airport002.title: Airport Ambulance
missions.arrive.italy.airport002.descrip: Deliver a patient to the hospital.
missions.arrive.italy.airport002.startSc:
The passenger has been overcome by illness on the flight here.

Deliver them to the hospital to get them the care they need!
missions.arrive.italy.airport003.title: Airport Chauffeur - Marina
missions.arrive.italy.airport003.descrip: Chauffeur your passenger to the marina.
missions.arrive.italy.airport003.startSc: Your customer has landed and has asked to be delivered to their marina.
missions.arrive.italy.airport004.title: Airport Chauffeur - Vehicle Dealership
missions.arrive.italy.airport004.descrip: Chauffeur your passenger to their new vehicle dealership.
missions.arrive.italy.airport004.startSc:
Your customer has just landed and wants to pick up their new vehicle!

Deliver them to the dealership.
missions.arrive.italy.airport005.title: Airport Chauffeur - Interceptor Delivery
missions.arrive.italy.airport005.descrip: Deliver the brand-new police interceptor to the police station.
missions.arrive.italy.airport005.startSc: A brand-new police vehicle has arrived, deliver it to the police station.
missions.arrive.italy.portinoTour.title: Portino to the Top
missions.arrive.italy.portinoTour.descri: A nice and long drive out of Portino to the castle with traffic.
missions.arrive.italy.portinoTour.startS:
Follow the ground markers around and up the back side of Italy, you will arrive at the gas station near the castle!

This drive is longer than usual, the Miramar provides a luxurious though possibly treacherous driving experience on this route! Have fun!
missions.arrive.wcusa.bastionExperience0: Bring the Bastion out to the shop near the motorsports park.

This lightly used Bastion needs to be re-certified! Our guys are too busy fixing all these old Bruckells, so bring it out to the Belasco City Garage near the track so they can give it a look over!

Don't forget the motorsports park is between here and there, so you need to take a route around it.

GPS road markers are not activated for this challenge, you'll have to find your own way to your destination!
Drop-off a recently-serviced customer vehicle downtown.

A customer has requested that we drop off their Bastion once we have finished servicing it. Bring it out to their downtown residence.

GPS road markers are not activated for this challenge, you'll have to find your own way to your destination!
Take the wild Bruckell Bastion Battlehawk out to the countryside.

One of Bruckell's most powerful vehicles has just been in for service. The client is away for the weekend and asked us to drop it off to their countryside home in the hills.

The easiest way to get there is over the highway. You can turn either left or right on the big intersection in front of the dealership and follow that road.

Drive with care, this vehicle means business!

GPS road markers are not activated for this challenge, you'll have to find your own way to your destination!

The new Police Variant has been finished, bring it by the police station downtown to let them admire our work!

GPS road markers are not activated for this challenge, you'll have to find your own way to your destination!
missions.aiRace.general.intro.flips.unli: You can flip your car upright as often as you want.
missions.aiRace.general.intro.flips.limi: You can flip your car upright up to {{flipLimit}} times.
missions.aiRace.general.intro.recover.un: Once you reach a checkpoint, you can recover your car back to it.
missions.aiRace.general.intro.recover.li: Once you reach a checkpoint, you can recover your car back to it, up to {{recoverLimit}} times.
missions.aiRace.general.start: Race with your opponents and try to get ahead of them before the finish line!
missions.aiRace.general.finishFirst: 1st place! You are the champion of this race!
missions.aiRace.general.finishSecond: 2nd place! That was an intense competition!
missions.aiRace.general.finishThird: 3rd place! Good run, you never gave up!
missions.aiRace.general.damageFail: You took too much damage to complete the race!
missions.aiRace.general.disqualified: You got disqualified from the race!
missions.aiRace.stars.justFinishPlayerVe: Complete the race with your vehicle of choice.
missions.aiRace.stars.finishGoldPlayerVe: Win the race with your vehicle of choice.
missions.aiRace.stars.finishGoalLaps: Complete the race after doing {{goalLaps}} or more laps.
missions.aiRace.stars.beatGoalTime: Win the race in under {{goalTime | time}}.
missions.aiRace.stars.cleanRace: Complete the race in an undamaged or lightly damaged vehicle.
missions.aiRace.stars.cleanGoldRace: Win the race in an undamaged or lightly damaged vehicle.
missions.aiRace.stars.lessCollisionsRace: Collide with other racers at most {{goalCollisionsLimit}} times.
missions.aiRace.stars.moreCollisionsRace: Collide with other racers at least {{goalCollisionsTarget}} times.
missions.aiRace.stars.trafficRace: Complete the race with traffic enabled.
missions.aiRace.stars.recoveries: Finish with having at most {{goalRecoveries}} combined flips and recoveries.
missions.aiRace.utah.ridgeRace.title: Ridge Race
missions.aiRace.utah.ridgeRace.descripti: A thrilling high-speed race from the tourist centre to the gas station.
missions.aiRace.utah.highwayBattle.title: Highway Battle
missions.aiRace.utah.highwayBattle.descr: Dangerous speeds and aggressive racers await you in this highway race.
missions.aiRace.utah.highwayBattle.start: Push to the limit along the highway, and find ways to push past the aggressive racers! Watch out for the sudden left turn before the highway tunnels.
missions.aiRace.utah.wildWest.title: Wild West Trails
missions.aiRace.utah.wildWest.descriptio: Race along the old and rough trails in Utah.
missions.aiRace.utah.wildWest.start: Race with some rally tuned cars along the dusty trails. Be careful, some corners are tighter than they might seem.
missions.aiRace.utah.G500Unreliable.desc: Can you finish this race with the unique Covet {{'ui.names.g500.altName' | translate}} build?
missions.aiRace.utah.G500Unreliable.star: Can you handle this crazy Covet throughout this dirt circuit race? You will need to be careful at every corner. Bonus points if you can beat all of the racers!
missions.hirochi_raceway.aiRace.Short.de: Bring your own vehicle and race against similarly capable opponents around the short course at Hirochi Raceway.
missions.hirochi_raceway.aiRace.Short.st: Race the AI around the short course at Hirochi Raceway.
missions.hirochi_raceway.aiRace.Medium.d: Bring your own vehicle and race against similarly capable opponents around the medium course at Hirochi Raceway.
missions.hirochi_raceway.aiRace.Medium.s: Race the AI around the medium course at Hirochi Raceway.
missions.hirochi_raceway.aiRace.Long.des: Bring your own vehicle and race against similarly capable opponents around the long course at Hirochi Raceway.
missions.hirochi_raceway.aiRace.Long.sta: Race the AI around the long course at Hirochi Raceway.
missions.aiRace.industrial.ILoop.title: Industrial Loop Race
missions.aiRace.industrial.ILoop.descrip: In this race you will face similar perfomance rated vehicle opponenets. The loop consists of some high speed straights. Orange mesh barriers have been placed as braking zone markers to help you know when to start slowing down.
missions.aiRace.industrial.ILoop.startTe: Take on the loop race here at Industrial Site.  Have you got what it takes to beat some similar opponent vehicles?
missions.aiRace.industrial.G500Dirty.des: Time to get dirty in this short course through the marsh!
missions.aiRace.industrial.G500Dirty.sta: Drive laps around this compact course and try to get ahead of the others. There will be a lot of dirt and mud to deal with.
missions.aiRace.italy.streetTour.title: Street Tour
missions.aiRace.italy.streetTour.descrip: Compete with some friends along this looped street race in Norte.
missions.aiRace.italy.streetTour.start: Drive laps and get ahead on this basic street course in Norte. Be sure to brake early for the left turn after the construction zone.
missions.aiRace.italy.scenicCoast.title: Scenic Coast
missions.aiRace.italy.scenicCoast.descri: A long and tough sprint race on the outer roads of Italy; good luck!
missions.aiRace.italy.scenicCoast.start: Are you ready for a real challenge? These eager speeders sure are. They said that they'll keep you behind in last place, so try to prove them wrong. The course is a long one; good luck!
missions.aiRace.italy.damCrossing.title: Dam Crossing
missions.aiRace.italy.damCrossing.descri: Race along the narrow mountain roads and across the dam, but be careful when overtaking.
missions.aiRace.italy.damCrossing.start: Fight for first place along this beautiful but tricky course. Sharp turns and narrow sections will really test your skills. Try not to get too pushy.
missions.aiRace.ecusa.theOne.title: The One to Beat
missions.aiRace.ecusa.theOne.description: A rival has challenged you to a road race; may the best driver win!
missions.aiRace.ecusa.theOne.start: A rival has challenged you! Can you come out on top in this intense duel?
missions.aiRace.ecusa.speedSense.title: Speed Sense
missions.aiRace.ecusa.speedSense.descrip: Show your skills and speed on this quick but dangerous route.
missions.aiRace.ecusa.speedSense.start: Experience real speed against some fully tuned racers! This course can be tricky and dangerous. If you drive too fast and carelessly, you're going to have a bad time.
missions.aiRace.ecusa.throughTown.title: Through Town
missions.aiRace.ecusa.throughTown.descri: Race against some rowdy teenagers through the peaceful town!
missions.aiRace.ecusa.throughTown.start: Drive laps around town while fending off the gang of teenaged racers. Try to manage good racing lines so that you can match or outplay the competition.
missions.aiRace.ecusa.logLaunch.title: Log Launch
missions.aiRace.ecusa.logLaunch.descript: Go for a rough ride along the rally-inspired route!
missions.aiRace.ecusa.logLaunch.start: This course features dirty trails and a quick tour through the sawmill. Try to keep your vehicle stable, and enjoy the ride!
missions.aiRace.ecusa.fearless.title: Fearless
missions.aiRace.ecusa.fearless.descripti: Defy fear and take risks in this race featuring large vehicles!
missions.aiRace.ecusa.fearless.start: Conquer the narrow forest roads and battle the local racers in this risky race. Watch out for blind corners!
missions.aiRace.ecusa.G500Sawmill.title: Sawmill Brawl - {{'ui.names.g500.name' | translate}}
missions.aiRace.ecusa.G500Sawmill.descri: Have some fun in a circuit race at the sawmill!
missions.aiRace.ecusa.G500Sawmill.start: Get ready for a casual yet exciting race versus some humble racers. Play nicely!
missions.small_island.aiRace.ring.title: Ring Road Race
missions.small_island.aiRace.ring.descri: Race the locals around the Small Island ring road. The legend has it that no one from outside the islands has ever managed to finish in first place.
missions.small_island.aiRace.ring.startT: Tight roads, ruthless locals, it's your turn now. Many have tried to beat them, unsuccessfully. Remember that your Piccolina only has a single carburetor so you will need to change gear at 4000RPM to keep in the power band. Your opponents may be faster in a straight line, but you will have the upper hand in the turns if you take them at the correct speeds.
missions.small_island.aiRace.irxcb.title: Rallycross Club Race
missions.small_island.aiRace.irxcb.descr: A fast loop through gravel and dirt. Make sure to keep the vehicle on the track. One little mistake can cost a lot.
missions.small_island.aiRace.irxcb.start: The locals are competing in an amateur style rallycross style race. Show them what you're made of. Good luck.
missions.aiRace.wcusa.circuit1.title: West Coast Circuit 1
missions.aiRace.wcusa.circuit1.descripti: Race with some competitors on the main circuit.
missions.aiRace.wcusa.highwayLoop1.title: Highway Loop 1
missions.aiRace.wcusa.highwayLoop1.descr: Reach extreme speeds on the highway with the Civetta Scintilla!
missions.aiRace.wcusa.highwayLoop1.start: The high performance Civetta Scintilla is a real thrill to push to its limits on the highway. Can you handle it around this high speed loop? Defeat the fierce opponents, and don't get too comfortable!
missions.aiRace.wcusa.highwayLoop2.title: Highway Loop 2
missions.aiRace.wcusa.highwayLoop2.descr: Reach extreme speeds on the highway versus super tuned cars!
missions.aiRace.wcusa.highwayLoop2.start: A high performance battle. Race at unbelievable speeds around the highway network, and try not to overshoot the trickier turns.
missions.aiRace.wcusa.basicRace.title: Basic Race
missions.aiRace.wcusa.basicRace.descript: Get warmed up with racing in this basic street challenge.
missions.aiRace.wcusa.basicRace.start: Get in a racing mood by beating these average drivers in their stock Covets! To succeed, you will need to slow down for corners and find ways to pass your opponents.
missions.aiRace.wcusa.goHome.title: Go Home
missions.aiRace.wcusa.goHome.description: Time to go home! Pass the other on your way to the suburbs.
missions.aiRace.wcusa.goHome.start: Race along the freeway to the suburbs and get to the house before the others do.
missions.aiRace.wcusa.streetRivals.title: Street Rivals
missions.aiRace.wcusa.streetRivals.descr: Feel the pressure in this thrilling street race through downtown.
missions.aiRace.wcusa.streetRivals.start: Take a thrilling tour of downtown while speeding with the street racers. Keep an eye out for some of the tricky sections of this course.
missions.aiRace.wcusa.driveTheDistance.d: Race across the area, from the dockyards to the garage.
missions.aiRace.wcusa.driveTheDistance.s: Race against the classic muscle cars. Stay focused, this course is long and passes through various locales.
missions.aiRace.wcusa.pipelineDrive.desc: Race through the logistics centre and along the pipeline.
missions.aiRace.wcusa.pipelineDrive.star: You've been matched with some intimidating opponents for this challenge. Don't worry; if you drive decently enough, you should be able to pass them. Mind the corners!
missions.industrial.aiRace.RXOval.title: RallyCross Oval
missions.industrial.aiRace.RXOval.descri: Take on the locals at the rallycross oval.
missions.industrial.aiRace.RXOval.startT: Take on the locals at the rallycross oval.
missions.industrial.timeTrial.track_rall: This long stage will give you a taste of a bit of everything that this map has to offer.
This long stage will give you a taste of a bit of everything that this map has to offer. Some sections require some careful negotiation.
missions.industrial.drift.Tire.title: Tire Wear House
missions.industrial.drift.Tire.descripti: An indoor gymkhana at the warehouse.
missions.west_coast_usa.drift.Yard.title: Yard Barker
missions.west_coast_usa.drift.Yard.descr: Score as many points as you can within the confines of the FAST Automotive yard.  The more difficult to achieve stunt zones will provide higher scores.
missions.west_coast_usa.drift.Shuffleboa: A Gymkhana setup at Shuffleboard Logistics.
missions.east_coast_usa.evade.Boxed.desc: Take the van from the gas station and evade capture.
missions.east_coast_usa.evade.Boxed.star: Take the box truck from the gas station and get out of there! Try to keep the police away from your air tanks or you will be stopped fast.
missions.east_coast_usa.timeTrial.strutb: An asphalt circuit with lots of suspension action.
This loop will put a lot of stress on suspension when traveled at speed. Hang on tight and try to find a rhythm.
missions.east_coast_usa.rallyStage.backr: Gravel stage with small tarmac sections. Bumpy sections and downhill braking zones require discipline and patience.
missions.italy.rallyStage.SScliffside.de: Winding mountain tarmac stage. Wide road masks the technical challenge.
Flowy climb up through orchard foothills on tarmac. Satisfying speed mixed with hairpins and some small jumps.
missions.west_coast_usa.timeTrial.garage: A tight and tricky course that loops back on it's self many times. You may need to practice this course slowly in order to learn the route.
Keep your eyes out for the checkpoints and try to learn the course before pushing too hard.
missions.west_coast_usa.chase.fragileass: Chase down the stolen bank truck, but don't destroy it if you can help it.
Arrest the thief that stole the bank truck, but be very careful not to wreck it.  The county doesn't have the budget to lose another armoured vehicle.
You lost track of the suspect!
The suspect's vehicle got badly damaged!
missions.chase.general.start: Chase the suspect, and bring the vehicle to a stop!
missions.chase.general.complete: Great job! Justice has been served.
missions.chase.general.timeBronze: Well done! Justice has been served. It took a while, though!
missions.chase.general.timeSilver: Awesome job! You caught the suspect within a pretty impressive time.
missions.chase.general.pass: What a struggle! Do you think you can do better?
missions.chase.general.timeFail: You took too long to complete the job!
missions.chase.general.distanceFail: You lost track of the suspect!
missions.chase.general.damageFail: You took too much damage to complete the job!
missions.chase.general.hideoutFail: The suspect arrived at their secure hideout!
missions.chase.general.suspectDamageFail: The suspect's vehicle got badly damaged!
missions.chase.general.collisionFail: You collided with the suspect's vehicle!
missions.chase.intro.timeLimit: Stop and arrest the suspect within the time limit of {{timeLimit | timeSimple}}.
missions.chase.intro.suspectHideout: Prevent the suspect from reaching the target destination.
missions.chase.intro.suspectDamageLimit: Avoid damaging the suspect vehicle too much.
missions.chase.stars.distanceBronze: Follow at an average distance of {{distanceBronze | unit: "lengthMinor"}}.
missions.chase.stars.distanceSilver: Follow at an average distance of {{distanceSilver | unit: "lengthMinor"}}.
missions.chase.stars.distanceGold: Follow at an average distance of {{distanceGold | unit: "lengthMinor"}}.
missions.chase.stars.lowDamageSuspect: Keep the other vehicle undamaged or lightly damaged.
missions.chase.stars.perfectArrest: Complete a perfect arrest (only one countdown).
missions.chase.stars.timedArrest: Win with a time between {{minTimeWindow | time}} and {{maxTimeWindow | time}}.
missions.chase.ecusa.vandalChase.title: Vandal Chase
missions.chase.ecusa.vandalChase.descrip: Stop the driver that is wanted for vandalism!
missions.chase.ecusa.vandalChase.start: A fellow known for vandalism has been spotted driving away from the town. Track him down and force the vehicle to a stop. Don't drive too recklessly.
missions.chase.ecusa.tackleTime.title: Tackle Time
missions.chase.ecusa.tackleTime.descript: A suspect with stolen goods has been spotted. Catch up and arrest him!
missions.chase.ecusa.tackleTime.start: A suspect with stolen goods has been spotted at the fishing village. Arrive at the scene, and prevent him from making a clean getaway.
missions.chase.italy.superSpeed.title: Super Speed
missions.chase.italy.superSpeed.descript: Can you handle the pressure in a high speed pursuit along the highway?
missions.chase.italy.superSpeed.start: Chase and stop the racer while they zip at extreme speeds along the highway. Good luck!
missions.chase.italy.pastaMaster.title: Pasta Master
missions.chase.italy.pastaMaster.start: A cheeky criminal has been spotted stealing loads of pasta from the storage room of a popular restaurant. Chase and stop the van before it gets to the safe house!
missions.chase.wcusa.unpaidFines.title: Unpaid Fines
missions.chase.wcusa.unpaidFines.descrip: Stop the driver who is unwilling to pay fines!
missions.chase.wcusa.unpaidFines.start: You've tracked down a driver that is wanted for a bunch of unpaid fines. Arrest them by forcing their vehicle to a stop! Then, keep them stuck until the timer runs out.
missions.chase.wcusa.tamperProof.title: Tamper Proof
missions.chase.wcusa.tamperProof.descrip: Arrive at the scene of the crime and stop the Hopper!
missions.chase.wcusa.tamperProof.start: You've received a call about a suspicious person tampering with the oil wells. Drive to the scene and take care of the situation.
missions.chase.wcusa.rowdyRacer.title: Rowdy Racer
missions.chase.wcusa.rowdyRacer.start: A wild driver is having too much fun roaring through the streets of downtown. Bring this fool to a stop.
missions.chase.wcusa.gasStationRobbery.d: Catch the robbery suspects before they get away!
missions.chase.wcusa.gasStationRobbery.s: A duo of robbers ravaged the store at the gas station. Drive to the destination, then take them down before they arrive at their safe place!
missions.chase.wcusa.dangerousSpeeds.des: Chase the speeder in a highspeed pursuit!
missions.chase.wcusa.dangerousSpeeds.sta: A fearless racer is ready to take off and leave you in the dust. Drive fast, hit accurately and try not to fall behind.
missions.chase.wcusa.houseArrest.title: House Arrest
missions.chase.wcusa.houseArrest.descrip: Someone is evading house arrest. Catch them before they disappear!
missions.chase.wcusa.houseArrest.start: Someone is evading house arrest. You've been tasked with taking them down. Catch them before they make it to the hideout!
missions.utah.crawl.HDW.title: Heavy Duty Work
missions.utah.crawl.HDW.description: Get the dump truck across the edge of the hill to the meet zone.
missions.utah.crawl.HDW.startScreenText: Get the dump truck across the edge of the hill to the meet zone.
missions.east_coast_usa.crawl.PCTA.title: Production Car Trials A
missions.east_coast_usa.crawl.PCTA.descr: Take on course A of the Firwood Production Car Trials competition.
missions.east_coast_usa.crawl.PCTA.start: Navigate the trials course through the checkpoints against the clock. Make sure to give yourself enough turning space and use the handbrake to help with the tighter sections.  Good luck.
missions.small_island.crawl.CTrialsA.des: Car Trials is a crawling challenge on a different level. Front wheel drive and in the dirt. Momentum is your friend.
missions.small_island.crawl.CTrialsA.sta: Car Trials is a crawling challenge on a different level. Front wheel drive and in the dirt. Momentum is your friend.
missions.small_island.knockAway.Downhill: Knock the barrels as you speed down the hill.
Follow the barrel strewn route to the end, knocking as many barrels as you can.
missions.west_coast_usa.crawl.freeformin: This course will introduce you to thinking about your route during an open range of obstacles. Plan to take the route of least resistance in order to maintain the smoothest ride.
missions.west_coast_usa.crawl.mediumcraw: This is an average difficulty course designed for mid range crawlers.
Follow the waypoints through the course, if you get stuck you can recover to the last checkpoint.
Can you conquer The Gauntlet?  This course will put the strongest of crawler builds to the test.
Take your time in places where it is hard to move.  Engage the locking differentials if you have them to gain more traction.
missions.west_coast_usa.crawl.easyCrawl0: This course will introduce you to big obstacles. Be careful and do not rush it, sometimes the best option is to take it slow and easy.

Take your time in places where it is hard to move and speed up when needed, but be careful, too much velocity and you may be punished. Engage the locking differentials if you have them to gain more traction.

This course will introduce you to dynamic obstacles. These props don't have good balance, so you will need to be very meticulous with your movements. Be careful and do not rush it, sometimes the best option is to take it slow and easy.

Take your time in places where it is hard to move and speed up when needed, but be careful, too much velocity and you may be punished. Engage the locking differentials if you have them to gain more traction.
missions.west_coast_usa.crawl.Helter.des: Get this old girl down the hill through the checkpoints, if you can.
missions.west_coast_usa.crawl.Helter.sta: Get this old girl down the hill through the checkpoints, if you can.
missions.italy.crawl.Cliffhanger.title: Cliffhanger
missions.italy.crawl.Cliffhanger.descrip: Only the bravest tackle this cliff side crawl challenge.
missions.italy.crawl.Cliffhanger.startSc: Only the bravest tackle this cliff side crawl challenge.
missions.evade.general.start: Flee from the police, and avoid getting taken down!
missions.evade.general.startDestination: Arrive at the marked destination, and make sure that the police are not near there to complete this challenge.
missions.evade.general.startDropOff: Arrive at the marked destination, then drive away and keep fleeing! Evade the police to complete this challenge.
missions.evade.general.startEscape: All you need to do is evade from the police by any means necessary! Try to figure out the best escape plan.
missions.evade.general.destinationPolice: The police are too close, come back later!
missions.evade.general.complete: Great job! No one can stop you.
missions.evade.general.timeBronze: You finally lost them! It took a while, but you managed to win in the end.
missions.evade.general.timeSilver: Great driving skills. That was a thrilling and brilliant escape.
missions.evade.general.timeGold: Awesome evasion! You are an expert getaway driver, for sure!
missions.evade.general.pass: What a struggle! You definitely ended up on the news for this.
missions.evade.intro.destinationSimple: Flee from the police and arrive at the marked destination.

Get the most points by parking in each marked parking space as quickly as possible.

  • If you finish before the time runs out, you'll get 1 point per remaining second.

missions.precisionParking.description.b2: • You can flip your car upright as often as you want, but lose {{flipPenalty}} points each time.

• When a marker has an arrow inside, you have to park in the matching orientation.

missions.timeTrial.west_coast_usa.wcusa_: Steep Bolt
Sharp turns, elevation changes, blind corners, and chicanes!

This retro-game-themed layout provides a mix of blind corners, elevation challenges, and chicanes.

Don't forget to pay attention to your vehicles weight transfer when entering and exiting corners, as every corner on this track takes place on an elevation change requiring unique racing lines depending on your drivetrain: FWD/RWD/AWD.
Cathedral Hill
Up, around the cathedral, and down!

Off-camber cornering mixed with some very fun and high-speed sweeping curves will lead you up to the cathedral and back. As long as you pay attention to those downhill corners, you should remain in one piece!

Brakes and suspension are put to the test on this otherwise simple course layout.
Belasco Core
High-speeds in the downtown core.

While primarily focused around the grid-like downtown Belasco City, this course provides elevation changes mixed with medium-speed right-angle cornering!

A quick trip going from downtown to the hills and back. This is one of those courses that rewards risk as quickly as it punishes it.
Fog Hill Shilly-Shally
Up to the Fog Hill Fire Station and back.

Bringing you up to the Fog Hill Fire Station, this course provides a fun hairpin and some great off-camber corners thanks to constant elevation changes!

Although you might be tempted to cut corners and hop the curb in some places, it's recommended to err on the side of caution with this track; those road-side trees and poles can do a real number on your vehicle!
Palisade Point
Up to the Palisades and back with some tricky corners.

Although simple from overhead, this course offers some off-camber downhill corners, and an incredibly tricky hairpin section near the end of the lap!

Race up to the Palisades and back, watch those curbs, and remember: the brake pedal is your friend.
Solar Circuit
Simple, old-school industrial fun.

This is a classic course designed to really test your self-control! With a couple of right-angle turns and a decreasing-radius corner directly leading into a mild curve, this track will really exercise when and how you apply the throttle.

Don't get carried away otherwise you'll quickly find that the curbs can be very unforgiving!
Estates Express
Mega high-speeds circling the residential area.

A very high-speed course that brings you around the perimeter of Belasco's suburbs.

From freeway to highway with tricky on-ramp and off-ramp sections, this course will put your ability of judge braking distances to the test: Wait too long and it will be catastrophic, brake too soon and lose precious seconds!
Horizon Sprint
High-speeds and grip-driving mixed together.

Starting off on the highway outside of the residential area, this route has a nice mix of high-speed and technical driving bringing you off of the highway and into the suburbs, then back to the highway again.

Watch those curbs, they could tweak your steering, or worse!

missions.dragRaceAPM.beginner.innerDescr:
Drag Racing Guide:
  • Pre-stage: Pull forward until the first yellow light illuminates
  • Stage: Inch forward until the second yellow light illuminates
  • Watch the countdown lights (Sportsman .500 tree):
    • Amber lights will sequence with 0.5 second intervals
    • Green light signals 'GO'
  • Red light: Disqualification (leaving before green)
Tip: Focus on consistent staging and reaction times for the best results.
missions.dragRaceAPM.beginner001.title: APM Beginner Covet 135 M
missions.dragRaceAPM.beginner001.descrip: Kick off drag racing with the Covet 135 M configuration. Learn the basics of launching and shifting as you strive to achieve the best time on the strip with this reliable FWD vehicle under the .500 (Sportsman) tree configuration.
missions.dragRaceAPM.beginner002.title: APM Beginner FCV Vivace 110 M
missions.dragRaceAPM.beginner002.descrip: Take control of the FCV Vivace 110 M, an agile FWD car perfect for perfecting your acceleration techniques. Focus on fast shifting and reaction timing to maximize your performance under the .500 (Sportsman) tree config.
missions.dragRaceAPM.beginner003.title: APM Beginner Pessima 2.0 LX M
missions.dragRaceAPM.beginner003.descrip: Master the drag strip with the Pessima 2.0 LX M. This midsize FWD sedan offers a balanced experience, helping you refine your racing skills and achieve competitive times under the beginner-friendly .500 (Sportsman) tree configuration.
missions.dragRaceAPM.intermediate.innerD:
Drag Racing Guide:
  • Pro Tree (.400): After staging, the time before amber lights illuminate is randomized, adding unpredictability. Then the amber lights will light up all at once and after 0.4 seconds the green light signals 'GO'
  • Launch Control: Optimize your launch RPM and minimize wheelspin
  • Shift Points: Find the perfect shift points for maximum acceleration
  • Reaction Time: Practice anticipating the light changes and maintain focus to improve your start times.
Tip: Success comes from balancing reaction time with consistent launches and shifts.
missions.dragRaceAPM.intermediate001.tit: APM Intermediate BX Series Diana GTz Turbo M
missions.dragRaceAPM.intermediate001.des: Step up to the BX Series Diana GTz Turbo M, a powerful RWD car. Tackle its performance by perfecting your shifting and throttle control under the more challenging .400 (Pro) tree configuration.
missions.dragRaceAPM.intermediate002.des: Push your limits with the K-series LC6x 360 M. This robust RWD vehicle challenges you to handle increased power and speed, aiming for exceptional drag times with the more complex .400 (Pro) tree configuration.
missions.dragRaceAPM.intermediate003.des: Test the Scintilla GTx (DCT), a dynamic AWD car built for speed. Focus on precise gear changes and optimal acceleration to excel in the .400 (Pro) tree configuration.
missions.dragRaceAPM.advanced.innerDescr:
Drag Racing Guide:
  • Bracket Racing: Is a format where the driver sets a target finish time before the race begins. The objective is to match your target time as closely as possible without going under it.
  • Dial Usage: The dial allows you to set your target time. This target time determines your vehicle's starting parameters, ensuring fair competition by accounting for differences in vehicle performance.
  • Trans Brake: Engage the trans brake if it's available to lock the transmission at the start line, providing a more stable launch and reducing wheelspin for a quicker reaction.
  • Nitrous Oxide (N2O): Utilize N2O if it's available to temporarily increase your engine's power, enhancing acceleration during critical phases of the race.
Tip: Success in bracket racing relies on precision and consistency. Practice setting realistic target times, refining your launch techniques, and effectively managing N2O and trans brake usage to consistently align your performance with your dial time without exceeding it.
missions.dragRaceAPM.advanced001.title: APM Advanced Covet Drag
missions.dragRaceAPM.advanced001.descrip: Test yourself at the advanced bracket racing mode with the Covet Drag configuration. Set your target time and use your skills to meet or beat it, navigating the challenges of high-performance racing under the .400 (Pro) tree and strategic dial settings.
missions.dragRaceAPM.advanced002.title: APM Advanced Bastion Drag
missions.dragRaceAPM.advanced002.descrip: Try your best with the Bastion Drag configuration. Utilize the dial settings and your refined driving techniques to achieve the fastest possible run under competitive conditions, mastering the .400 (Pro) tree configuration.
missions.dragRaceAPM.advanced003.title: APM Advanced Nine Drag Van
missions.dragRaceAPM.advanced003.descrip: Take on the Nine Drag Van in an advanced bracket race. Balance precision and speed as you aim to surpass your target time, showcasing your mastery of advanced drag racing skills with the .400 (Pro) tree config and strategic dial adjustments.
missions.dragRace.gameplay.title: Drag Race
missions.dragRace.gameplay.description: To compete in the race, you must first 'stage' at the start line. As you pull up to the line you will see the lights at the top of the lighting system activate. Once you are on the line, both sets of lights will be on. Once staged, wait for the green light to start the race. Drive as fast as you can to the finish line. The vehicle is in realistic behaviour so you will have to manage the gearbox yourself. To do this, use [action=shiftUp] to shift up, [action=shiftDown] to shift down and [action=clutch] to use the clutch if applicable. Good luck!
